purpose: Semantic dictionary management record, not JSON Schema, physical storage schema, entity-table design, runtime DTO contract or Rust type definition.

packages.name: Material states, quantities and local descriptions

information_products.name: Material and representation definition
information_products.meaning: Meaning of identified constituents, lumps, chemical/reporting coordinates, nonbulk domains and justified bases.
information_products.record_context: An assessed material description before runtime binding; draft assertions may be unresolved.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One representation revision; one or more constituent meanings and coordinate/basis/domain descriptions. Optional distribution/site definitions are required only when that representation uses them.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Canonical material meaning, not a physical account or an EOS configuration.

information_products.name: Representation map and reduction definition
information_products.meaning: A declared forward mapping with conserved quantities and information-loss/inverse limits.
information_products.record_context: A map definition with a declared source and target.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: Exactly one source and one target representation, a forward rule/constraint relation, conservation claims and explicit inverse/loss conditions.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Applying the map creates a new mapped description, not a second inventory or an implied inverse.

information_products.name: Property evidence and resolved parameter snapshot
information_products.meaning: Actual selected observations/coefficients or attributable provider data bundle, precedence and limitations.
information_products.record_context: A fixed data selection for a declared use or trial.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One snapshot; selected assertions/bundles or an explicit parameter-free determination; source/override lineage and unresolved prerequisites.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Known-zero, missing, rule-derived, fitted and substituted values remain distinct.

information_products.name: Characterization/fit proposal
information_products.meaning: Original assay or fitting evidence, recipe, trials and proposed changes to A01/A03.
information_products.record_context: A preparation campaign outcome, including a failed campaign.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One captured recipe/input set; zero or more trials; one assessment; zero or one selected coordinated change proposal.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Candidate identities/data remain proposals until accepted by their semantic owners and P10.

information_products.name: Chemical definition and participation description
information_products.meaning: Reactions, rate/equilibrium conventions, admitted/frozen/kinetic subsets, reservoirs and conserved basis.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One chemical system with justified species/domains and conserved bases; optional enumerated reactions/laws, apparent/true reconciliation and reservoir requirements.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: One coupled phase/chemistry problem is permitted; a separate chemistry solver is not required.

information_products.name: Configured thermodynamic package revision
information_products.meaning: Resolved coherent methods, referenced material/data/chemistry, physical defaults, compatibility and caloric conventions.
information_products.record_context: A fixed package revision, which need not be fully validated.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One resolved method/material/data/convention bundle, default eligibility and at least one explicit compatibility assessment, even if partly unassessed.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: No local stream state, live handle or implicit current-material context.

information_products.name: Region/location binding
information_products.meaning: Effective assignment and local policy overlay, distinct from a runtime current-stream pointer.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: Exactly one location, one package revision and a resolution trace; zero or more authorized local overlays and boundary prerequisites.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Different locations can share a definition while retaining independent state and restrictions.

information_products.name: Local material description
information_products.meaning: Amounts, intensive coordinates, roles, actual/incipient phases, configuration references and possible unresolved quantities.
information_products.record_context: A local snapshot with known, absent and unresolved quantities explicitly distinguished.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One material account; one or more composition descriptions; zero or more local domain entries and optional distribution/site/transfer descriptions.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: State, flow, inventory and reference amount are distinct; reporting views are non-additive.

information_products.name: Calculation problem and authority contract
information_products.meaning: Original constraints, unknowns, permitted changes, required/optional outputs and declared physical scope.
information_products.record_context: An original physical problem or intentionally partial mathematical demand.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One operation contract, one captured package context, one constraint set and one authority allocation; one or more input descriptions and requested outputs/checks.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Attempts, guesses and changed-physics alternatives never overwrite original request meaning.

information_products.name: Readiness assessment
information_products.meaning: Request-scoped aggregation criteria with referenced constituent assessments, not a package-wide ready flag.
information_products.record_context: A request-specific qualification at a captured context.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One package/demand descriptor; a complete set of applicable prerequisite conclusions and supporting attestations; each unknown remains explicit.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Ready to attempt is not converged or independently validated.

information_products.name: Provider realization/capability attestation
information_products.meaning: Concrete build/binding/data identity, exposed operation subset, initialization and dependency limits.
information_products.record_context: An exposed realization and its bounded capability facts.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One exact engine/build/binding/data manifest; one or more realized operation mappings, native-coordinate and lifecycle restrictions where applicable.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Upstream catalog or method signature does not establish adapter capability.

information_products.name: Execution plan and numerical workspace
information_products.meaning: Algorithms, initializer guesses and temporary iterates of one captured request; not approved material state.
information_products.record_context: A planned or active numerical attempt.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One physical problem, one realization and one numerical policy; zero or more initializer descriptions; active workspace/session association only when needed.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Plan and disposable working memory differ; only the reproducible recipe/evidence belongs in the semantic archive.

information_products.name: Provider candidate and execution evidence
information_products.meaning: Normalized P04 values plus actually used methods, residuals, errors, search and convergence facts.
information_products.record_context: A terminated or intermediate candidate from an identified attempt.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One producing attempt; zero or more normalized payloads; explicit per-output status, actual used assumptions, numerical evidence and actual exchanges.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: No automatic acceptance, complete-property guarantee or current-result authority.

information_products.name: Qualification and acceptance evidence
information_products.meaning: Assessment of a candidate against the original request and a declared local/unit/flowsheet scope.
information_products.record_context: An assessment against the original criteria and requested scope.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One candidate/set and original problem/scope context; required checks each have pass/fail/unassessed/inapplicable evidence; lineage and precise outcome.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Scientific/local acceptance does not establish currentness or parent-scope convergence.

information_products.name: Current-result publication binding
information_products.meaning: Association of an accepted result with a matching current location/model revision and permitted run/scope.
information_products.record_context: A successful or rejected guarded publication and resulting current association.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One proposal/decision with qualification, context and run guards; committed binding slots reference one coherent result set each; related slots update as a group.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: P10 owns current association, not the physical law or scientific judgment.

information_products.name: Change and reconstruction record
information_products.meaning: Committed revision, dependency impacts, archive manifests, migrations and restored-readiness status.
information_products.record_context: A revision/change/archive/reconstruction event or captured context.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: Explicit record variant: captured revision, proposed/committed change, archive, reconstruction/reproduction, or run authority. Required variant fields cannot be replaced by a universal property bag.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: A loaded document can be inspectable but not ready; runtime handles are not semantic content.

information_products.name: Coverage and independent validation record
information_products.meaning: Bounded R/E/V and conformance claims with absent evidence explicit.
information_products.record_context: A bounded coverage claim and its evidence.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One scenario/configuration/envelope claim; separate R/E/V/conformance/reproduction dimensions; actual witnesses only when they exist.
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Catalog completion cannot promote numerical execution, and unknown evidence cannot be a pass.

information_products.name: Unit demands, coupling and routing description
information_products.meaning: Process-owned balances, phase-to-product roles, heat/material boundaries and required completion hierarchy.
information_products.record_context: The thermodynamic boundary of a chosen process formulation.
information_products.minimum_semantic_content: One unit mode and participating location set; required property/equation demands; balance/coupling/routing rules and explicit completion hierarchy; optional translation case(s).
information_products.non_conflation_rule: Equipment geometry, global equation construction and process solve remain host responsibilities.

concepts.name: Constituent identity
concepts.meaning: What a represented constituent is, independently of the database name, numerical coordinate, local amount, or selected property method. A constituent may be a chemically identified species or an explicitly defined engineering surrogate.
concepts.identity_rule: Stable entity identity plus a revision of its defining description. A display-name change does not create another material; changing a surrogate's defining cut or blend can require a new definition revision or a distinct constituent, with an explicit equivalence decision.

fields.name: Identity kind
fields.meaning: Chemically identified, assay-defined cut, specified lump, empirical material, pseudo-pure surrogate, or another registered meaning.
fields.unit_or_basis: Categorical meaning, not a required enumeration.

fields.name: Defining description
fields.meaning: Sufficient identity criteria for the kind; chemical structure/formula evidence where justified, or cut/assay/blend/empirical criteria otherwise.
fields.unit_or_basis: Formula, composition basis, boiling-cut test basis, or other explicitly stated descriptors.

fields.name: Assertions and aliases
fields.meaning: Supporting identities and names; ambiguities are retained until resolved.
fields.unit_or_basis: Names are not conserved material quantities.

fields.name: Conservation description
fields.meaning: Justified mass, elemental, charge, site or other accounting meaning; absent chemical detail does not mean zero atoms.
fields.unit_or_basis: Declared conserved basis; molecular weight only when justified.

fields.name: Derivation origin
fields.meaning: Source or characterization proposal supporting this identity; a derived cut keeps its origin.
fields.unit_or_basis: Provenance references.

invariants: Do not synthesize molecular weight, formula, charge, or registry identifiers to satisfy a provider.
A species identity does not require its own local amount to be positive.
Solid form identity or a phase-specific species convention must remain distinguishable when the chosen model requires it.
permitted_variants: A shared chemical identity with separate phase-state instances.
An empirically defined mass constituent with no molecular description.
A surrogate of a blend, explicitly not identical to the detailed blend representation.
concepts.lifecycle: Draft assertions become an assessed identity proposal; P10 commits revisions. Existing results retain the identity revision they used.
concepts.valid_example: An assay-derived 180–220 degree boiling cut is identified by assay, test convention and cut definition, not given a fictional registry number.
concepts.invalid_example: Two equal display names are merged despite different defining cut ranges.

concepts.name: Identity assertion and alias resolution
concepts.meaning: A sourced statement connecting a name, external identifier, or identity claim to a constituent. The assertion may be unresolved or contested.
concepts.identity_rule: Assertion identity includes issuer/namespace, asserted value, source and scope; resolving the assertion creates evidence, not an unlogged overwrite of identity.

fields.name: Namespace and asserted value
fields.meaning: Provider-local name, registry identifier, local tag, formula claim or synonym and its namespace.
fields.unit_or_basis: Text with explicit namespace; case/normalization rules declared.

fields.name: Candidate constituents
fields.meaning: Possible interpretations. Exactly one target is required only when the assertion is declared resolved.
fields.unit_or_basis: Identity references.

fields.name: Evidence
fields.meaning: Source and context establishing or qualifying the association.
fields.unit_or_basis: Provenance, not a numeric confidence inferred from a match.

fields.name: Resolution status
fields.meaning: Unresolved, unique, ambiguous, rejected or superseded association, including the reason.
fields.unit_or_basis: Assessment vocabulary.

fields.name: Applicability
fields.meaning: Provider/version, project, dataset or time scope within which the alias is valid.
fields.unit_or_basis: Explicit scope; no universal-name assumption.

invariants: A lookup with multiple candidates remains ambiguous.
A provider name is never silently promoted to the canonical physical identity.
permitted_variants: A project-local alias may resolve only within one representation.
An external registry assertion may be shared across configurations.
concepts.lifecycle: Append resolution or supersession evidence; preserve the originally imported assertion.
concepts.valid_example: The local tag SOLVENT refers to a particular mixture definition in one project, not universally to a species.
concepts.invalid_example: Choosing the first database hit and recording it as a verified identity.

concepts.name: Material representation revision
concepts.meaning: The constituent and coordinate vocabulary used to describe a material. It is not the physical inventory and is not the thermodynamic package.
concepts.identity_rule: Representation lineage plus exact revision. Constituent membership or interpretation changes produce a new revision; mere display ordering is not a physical change.

fields.name: Constituent set
fields.meaning: Allowed constituent identities, including admissible reaction products with zero current amount.
fields.unit_or_basis: Identity revisions, not amounts.

fields.name: Coordinate descriptions
fields.meaning: Permitted amount/fraction and detailed/apparent/lumped coordinate descriptions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Explicit bases and normalization domains.

fields.name: Domain definitions
fields.meaning: Bulk, solid, nonbulk or empirical material-domain meanings usable by the representation.
fields.unit_or_basis: Domain semantics; not a count of present phases.

fields.name: Justified accounting bases
fields.meaning: At least one meaningful accounting basis; no universal requirement for chemical element data.
fields.unit_or_basis: Mass, element amount, charge, sites or other justified conservation.

fields.name: Maps to other representations
fields.meaning: Declared coordinate transformations, aggregations or chemical reconciliation links.
fields.unit_or_basis: Map revisions.

fields.name: Extension definitions
fields.meaning: Distribution and site/loading meanings; numerical support is separate.
fields.unit_or_basis: Attribute coordinate, weighting and denominator semantics.

invariants: Two simultaneous descriptions of the same material must not create two additive inventories.
A draft may have unresolved constituent identity, but cannot be declared fully resolved.
Adding species changes coordinates and eligibility assessments; it is not merely resizing a numerical vector.
permitted_variants: Petroleum compositional cuts, black-oil bulk description, mass-only empirical description.
concepts.lifecycle: P01 validates meaning; P10 adopts a representation revision and any coupled mapping/quantity changes.
concepts.valid_example: Apparent salt feed and true ionic representation are linked views of one material account.
concepts.invalid_example: Summing apparent salt and its dissociated ions as independently present mass.

concepts.name: Composition coordinate system
concepts.meaning: The meaning of a constituent vector or constrained coordinate chart, including which total and constituent set its numbers refer to.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity fixes representation revision, coordinate kind, ordering/chart and normalization domain. Equivalent permutations are recorded maps, not changed physical mixtures.

fields.name: Representation
fields.meaning: Constituent meanings to which the coordinates refer.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact representation revision.

fields.name: Coordinates and order
fields.meaning: Ordered constituent references, independent variables or explicitly defined transformed coordinates.
fields.unit_or_basis: Per-coordinate basis; no unlabeled vector.

fields.name: Coordinate kind
fields.meaning: Component amounts/rates, normalized fractions, ratios, or an independent composition chart.
fields.unit_or_basis: Mole, mass, concentration, carrier ratio or declared basis.

fields.name: Normalization and denominator
fields.meaning: Whole mixture, named phase, solvent, dry carrier, or other stated domain; includes reference state if volume based.
fields.unit_or_basis: A positive denominator is required for a numerical ratio, not for preserving a zero-flow feed composition specification.

fields.name: Dependent-coordinate rule
fields.meaning: For reduced charts, reconstruct dependent coordinates and state admissible domain; required whenever not all full coordinates are independent.
fields.unit_or_basis: Example x_N=1−sum(x_1…x_(N−1)); logarithms need positive coordinates and a declared convention.

fields.name: Conversion prerequisites
fields.meaning: Data and conventions needed for basis or chart conversion; unknown prerequisites block that conversion only.
fields.unit_or_basis: Molecular weights, solvent mass, density model or chart Jacobian as applicable.

invariants: Fraction vectors are not independent coordinates unless a chart specifies their constraints.
Provider permutations and scientific coordinate transformations are distinct.
A concentration, molality and mole fraction are not interchangeable because all mention a species.
permitted_variants: Full mass fraction vector with sum constraint.
Component mass flows without a separately authoritative total.
concepts.lifecycle: Revise when coordinate meaning changes; preserve the old chart for derivative and result interpretation.
concepts.valid_example: A derivative chart fixes x_1 and x_2 as independent and defines x_3=1−x_1−x_2.
concepts.invalid_example: A derivative with respect to x_1 silently holds every other mole fraction fixed while also requiring their sum to remain one.

concepts.name: Conserved-quantity basis
concepts.meaning: Which material quantities can be conserved and how they are calculated from a stated representation. Conservation is conditional on the physical operation and modeled exchanges.
concepts.identity_rule: Basis identity includes quantity kinds, representation, conversion rules and justified-data provenance; a label such as mass is not enough to interpret an arbitrary coordinate vector.

fields.name: Representation and coordinates
fields.meaning: Input coordinates on which accounting is defined.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact amount/rate basis.

fields.name: Conserved quantities
fields.meaning: Named totals justified for this material; chemical elements/charge only when meaningful.
fields.unit_or_basis: Mass, molar element amount, charge equivalents, sites or specified quantity dimensions.

fields.name: Conversion rule
fields.meaning: Linear matrix when justified, or explicitly declared nonlinear/empirical mapping with prerequisites.
fields.unit_or_basis: For b=A n, each matrix entry carries target-units per input-amount-unit.

fields.name: Evidence and completeness
fields.meaning: Complete, partial or unassessed basis and the source of coefficients/conventions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Missing rows or entries are not zeros.

fields.name: Applicable transformations
fields.meaning: Operations under which a quantity is conserved and terms that can cross the boundary.
fields.unit_or_basis: Reaction, phase transfer, mechanical split or open exchange distinctions.

invariants: A nonreactive phase split preserves constituent totals; chemistry need not preserve molecular mole count.
Physical exchange changes account totals; conservation is checked on the system plus declared exchange.
Missing elemental information cannot yield a passed elemental balance.
permitted_variants: Site inventory and surface species with explicit occupancy relations.
concepts.lifecycle: P01 maintains meaning; assessment of an actual residual belongs to P09.
concepts.valid_example: A mass-only particulate model checks kg/s while declining elemental-balance claims.
concepts.invalid_example: Treating unreported atoms of an empirical solid as zero and certifying an element balance.

concepts.name: Material-domain definition
concepts.meaning: The kind of physical domain in which a material description is meaningful, without asserting a local phase exists or choosing an equilibrium model.
concepts.identity_rule: Domain-definition identity denotes semantics; local domain instances belong to P04 and process locations to P07.

fields.name: Domain kind
fields.meaning: Bulk fluid, identified solid or solid solution, empirical solid, surface/site inventory, membrane-side bulk, or explicit additional kind.
fields.unit_or_basis: Qualitative physical meaning.

fields.name: Admissible quantity bases
fields.meaning: Allowed stored amounts, flows, loadings or material attributes for that kind.
fields.unit_or_basis: Extensive and intensive bases are stated separately.

fields.name: Constituent interpretation
fields.meaning: How constituents participate in the domain; distinction between physical species and reported surrogates.
fields.unit_or_basis: Uses representation meanings.

fields.name: Specialized attributes
fields.meaning: Distribution/site or other registered domain semantics required beyond ordinary amounts.
fields.unit_or_basis: Defined support/denominator and transfer meaning.

invariants: A domain category is not a runtime phase instance.
Bulk phase, surface, interface and equipment compartment are not automatically synonymous.
Do not infer transfer, kinetics or equilibrium from the domain label.
permitted_variants: One domain definition can describe many liquid instances.
A membrane interface may relate two domains without being an independent stored material amount.
concepts.lifecycle: Definitions are reusable; local creation/deletion does not mutate their meaning.
concepts.valid_example: Two distinct liquids share liquid-domain semantics but have separate compositions and result-local identities.
concepts.invalid_example: Creating a fake liquid to store an adsorbed surface amount with no defined liquid volume.

concepts.name: Representation map and reduction
concepts.meaning: A declared relation between two descriptions of material: permutation, basis conversion, aggregation, constrained reconstruction, or a map requiring a separate chemical solution.
concepts.identity_rule: Map revision identifies source/target representations, direction, prerequisites, rule and information-loss statement. A reverse relation is not implied.

fields.name: Source representation
fields.meaning: Domain and coordinates of the original description.
fields.unit_or_basis: Representation revision and input basis.

fields.name: Target representation
fields.meaning: Domain and coordinates of the resulting description.
fields.unit_or_basis: Representation revision and output basis.

fields.name: Mapping rule
fields.meaning: Exact linear rule, conditional nonlinear conversion, aggregation or constraints requiring a solve.
fields.unit_or_basis: Units per coefficient or complete functional convention.

fields.name: Conservation claims
fields.meaning: Which justified totals are preserved, conditionally preserved or unassessed.
fields.unit_or_basis: Input and output accounting bases.

fields.name: Information loss and inverse
fields.meaning: Retained/lost distinctions; inverse available, conditional, many-to-one, or unavailable.
fields.unit_or_basis: Additional reconstruction data or prior-policy assumptions explicitly named.

fields.name: Applicability and dependencies
fields.meaning: States, data, convention or chemistry prerequisites of the map.
fields.unit_or_basis: No fixed map asserted for state-dependent speciation.

invariants: For a linear amount map n_t=M n_s, claimed exact conservation requires A_t M=A_s on the stated domain.
If chemical reactions make reverse reporting nonunique, report the selected attribution convention rather than inventing unique molecules.
A provider permutation preserves meaning; a lumping map can destroy information.
permitted_variants: Invertible permutation or units/basis conversion with data.
Constraint relation delegated to an explicit speciation operation.
concepts.lifecycle: Revisioned definition; each application keeps its own source snapshot, assumptions and result.
concepts.valid_example: Combining masses of A and B into one lump preserves total mass but records the lost A:B split.
concepts.invalid_example: Recovering a unique A:B composition from lump mass alone.

concepts.name: Distributed attribute definition
concepts.meaning: The meaning of a distribution or moments attached to material, such as a chain-length or particle-size description. It is not simply an arbitrary list of numbers.
concepts.identity_rule: Definition fixes support coordinate, weighting measure, normalization, attribute scope and permitted reductions.

fields.name: Support coordinates
fields.meaning: Chain length, size, mass or other defined coordinate and its domain/bins.
fields.unit_or_basis: Coordinate units; discrete masses versus probability densities distinguished.

fields.name: Weighting and normalization
fields.meaning: Number-, mole-, mass- or another justified measure; total measure or normalized distribution.
fields.unit_or_basis: Integral/sum convention and denominator.

fields.name: Material association
fields.meaning: Which constituent/domain or representation the attribute qualifies.
fields.unit_or_basis: Definition references, not local quantity.

fields.name: Reduction rules
fields.meaning: Moments/statistics retained and information lost; normalization and weighting are part of each moment.
fields.unit_or_basis: Moment dimensions depend on support and weighting.

fields.name: Transformation assumptions
fields.meaning: Permitted mixing, transfer and moment conversions and required conversion data.
fields.unit_or_basis: No automatic conservation of every moment under reactions or size change.

invariants: A number-weighted mean and mass-weighted mean remain different observables.
A probability density has coordinate-dependent units; bin weights are not densities.
A reduced moment set does not specify a unique full distribution without additional assumptions.
permitted_variants: Finite moments with explicit lost information.
concepts.lifecycle: Reusable meaning; local attribute values appear in IC-32 and inherit their own result/input roles.
concepts.valid_example: A mass-weighted particle-size histogram is mixed using material mass weights over reconciled bins.
concepts.invalid_example: Averaging two normalized histograms equally despite unequal associated masses.

concepts.name: Surface/site and loading basis
concepts.meaning: The denominator, capacity, species occupancy and conserved-material interpretation of an adsorbed or other nonbulk quantity.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity fixes loading convention, domain and occupancy relationships. Geometry/amount values belong to process context or local state, not this reusable meaning.

fields.name: Domain and constituent meaning
fields.meaning: Surface/site domain and relevant constituent definitions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Domain and representation revision.

fields.name: Loading denominator
fields.meaning: Surface area, dry sorbent mass, site amount or other explicitly defined denominator.
fields.unit_or_basis: For example mol/kg dry sorbent or mol/m²; wet and dry masses are not interchangeable.

fields.name: Occupancy and capacity relation
fields.meaning: Required when capacity/site constraints are claimed; relation of occupied/vacant sites and species amounts.
fields.unit_or_basis: Stoichiometric site occupancy and capacity units.

fields.name: Transfer accounting rule
fields.meaning: How loading converts to actual stored material and changes on exchange.
fields.unit_or_basis: Amount=loading×actual denominator only under the declared basis relation.

fields.name: Prerequisite context
fields.meaning: Denominator values and provider/model inputs required at a local location.
fields.unit_or_basis: No assumed unit area or unit sorbent mass as physical fact.

invariants: Loading without its denominator cannot establish total stored amount.
Vacant-site bookkeeping is not additional bulk chemical mass unless the model explicitly defines it.
Surface capacity is not automatically a thermodynamic phase fraction.
permitted_variants: Site occupancy with explicit multidentate stoichiometry.
concepts.lifecycle: P3 semantics defined; actual adsorption/membrane numerical execution remains a separate capability.
concepts.valid_example: 0.2 mol/kg dry sorbent at 5 kg dry sorbent corresponds to 1 mol stored under the defined total-loading convention.
concepts.invalid_example: Reading 0.2 mol/kg as 0.2 mol without sorbent quantity.

concepts.name: Evidence-source record
concepts.meaning: An attributable source for identity, property, parameter, model or validation statements. Presence of a citation is not a quality endorsement.
concepts.identity_rule: Source identity fixes edition/artifact/locator and provenance. A moving URL alone cannot identify the exact data used.

fields.name: Source identity and locator
fields.meaning: Document/database/artifact identifier, version or snapshot, and relevant location.
fields.unit_or_basis: Attribution metadata.

fields.name: Recorded artifact evidence
fields.meaning: Checksum or archived snapshot where accessible; otherwise explicit reproduction limitation.
fields.unit_or_basis: Artifact identity, not scientific truth.

fields.name: Original conventions
fields.meaning: Units, definitions, conditions and reported interpretation retained from the source.
fields.unit_or_basis: Do not rewrite historical source conventions to current defaults.

fields.name: Quality and uncertainty statements
fields.meaning: What the source actually establishes, uncertainty, method and evaluation status.
fields.unit_or_basis: Unknown uncertainty is not zero.

fields.name: Access/dependency conditions
fields.meaning: Known data availability/redistribution constraints and missing-resource facts.
fields.unit_or_basis: No independent legal certification implied.

invariants: Do not label library data critically evaluated without evidence.
A source artifact, a derived value and an acceptance test are different records.
permitted_variants: Pinned provider-data bundle with partially opaque internals.
User assertion with limited supporting evidence.
concepts.lifecycle: Preserve prior snapshots; later source revisions add new evidence and do not rewrite historical provenance.
concepts.valid_example: A fitted coefficient links to an exact input dataset and method record.
concepts.invalid_example: A bare current database name replaces the original source of a historical result.

concepts.name: Property datum and observation
concepts.meaning: A measured, reported or externally supplied property datum before selecting it for a model. It retains conditions and uncertainty rather than being mistaken for a universal constant.
concepts.identity_rule: Observation identity belongs to its source/sample/measurement or imported record. Replicates are separate observations unless explicitly aggregated.

fields.name: Observed quantity meaning
fields.meaning: Property, material/domain, basis, original units and relevant convention declared as source descriptors.
fields.unit_or_basis: Scalar, vector or tensor axes; no dependency on a live evaluation request.

fields.name: Material and experimental context
fields.meaning: Constituents/composition and known phase/experimental conditions; unresolved context labeled.
fields.unit_or_basis: Stated T,P,composition,basis and measurement conditions.

fields.name: Value or interval
fields.meaning: Reported value, bounds or censored observation, not a missing value filled by zero.
fields.unit_or_basis: Original quantity units and any explicit conversion record.

fields.name: Uncertainty and correlation
fields.meaning: Reported standard/expanded/interval/unknown uncertainty; coverage and correlation-group information where known.
fields.unit_or_basis: Uncertainty dimensions/covariance units and coverage factors as stated.

fields.name: Source and validity
fields.meaning: Attribution and documented conditions under which the datum is applicable.
fields.unit_or_basis: Source bounds distinct from model fit or solver search bounds.

invariants: Unavailable uncertainty must not imply independent exact observations.
A temperature-dependent datum is not a constant merely because it is stored as one number.
permitted_variants: Correlated experimental series with shared covariance information.
concepts.lifecycle: Immutable source observation; normalization or regression produces separately attributable derivatives/proposals.
concepts.valid_example: A binary VLE observation retains both phase compositions and reported temperature/pressure.
concepts.invalid_example: Dropping the measured phase designation and using the value for any phase.

concepts.name: Parameter interpretation descriptor
concepts.meaning: The meaning of a parameter or parameter group required by a method, including its equation convention and how absence is interpreted. P03 supplies method needs in this vocabulary.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity fixes the method-specific formula/convention, roles and coordinate orientation, not just a coefficient name.

fields.name: Method and formula descriptor
fields.meaning: Explicit method identity/convention or attributable inseparable-bundle descriptor; includes temperature functional form.
fields.unit_or_basis: Descriptor values, not a runtime package reference.

fields.name: Subject roles
fields.meaning: Pure constituent, ordered pair, symmetric pair, group pair, site association or other roles.
fields.unit_or_basis: Ordered roles remain ordered unless symmetry is declared.

fields.name: Parameter components
fields.meaning: Coefficient names and exact formula roles; parameter groups can be inseparable.
fields.unit_or_basis: Units for each coefficient and independent-variable units.

fields.name: Missing-value policy
fields.meaning: Required, rule-derived, omitted interaction, documented default, or unsupported; no generic zero rule.
fields.unit_or_basis: Policy identity plus model meaning.

fields.name: Interpretation prerequisites
fields.meaning: Reference conventions, support domain, group definitions or required context.
fields.unit_or_basis: Functional arguments and their allowed coordinates.

invariants: Same coefficient labels in different formulas are not interchangeable.
Directed interactions cannot be silently symmetrized.
A user-specified zero is not missing data; an omitted interaction is a physical meaning.
permitted_variants: Provider-bundled parameter interpretation with stated opacity.
concepts.lifecycle: Revision when formula, units, roles or missing-value meaning changes.
concepts.valid_example: An A+B/T expression records that A is dimensionless and B has temperature units under its stated formula.
concepts.invalid_example: Copying A12 from a different parameter convention solely because its column has the same name.

concepts.name: Parameter value assertion
concepts.meaning: One candidate value or value group under a precise parameter interpretation, with source, validity, derivation and approval status kept separate.
concepts.identity_rule: Assertion identity fixes interpretation, subjects, source/derivation and value revision. Several competing assertions can coexist.

fields.name: Interpretation and subjects
fields.meaning: Parameter descriptor and actual constituent/group/site role bindings.
fields.unit_or_basis: Role-specific exact identity revisions.

fields.name: Value state and payload
fields.meaning: Explicit known-zero, known-nonzero, missing, rule-derived, omitted-interaction or substituted value state; payload only where meaningful.
fields.unit_or_basis: Descriptor units and function convention.

fields.name: Evidence and derivation
fields.meaning: Source, fitting trial, estimation or explicit user choice.
fields.unit_or_basis: Measured, fitted, estimated and substituted origins distinguished.

fields.name: Validity and uncertainty
fields.meaning: Applicability, uncertainty and correlation with other parameters where established.
fields.unit_or_basis: Missing uncertainty remains unknown.

fields.name: Selection/approval role
fields.meaning: Candidate, trial, selected, approved or superseded role and authorizing record where applicable.
fields.unit_or_basis: Approval does not establish physical validation.

invariants: A failed estimate does not silently install near-ideal coefficients in an existing approved set.
Correlated fit coefficients retain joint uncertainty evidence when available.
permitted_variants: Rule-derived pair value with recorded combining rule.
User-authorized substitute with a bounded applicability claim.
concepts.lifecycle: New assertion for new values; selection into snapshots is explicit and trial state does not alter approved data.
concepts.valid_example: A missing directed interaction remains unresolved while a deliberate zero interaction is evaluable under its descriptor.
concepts.invalid_example: Storing both missing and specified-zero as 0 and later claiming identical provenance.

concepts.name: Resolved parameter snapshot
concepts.meaning: The fixed selected data supplied to a package or explicit trial, including the selection/override precedence and known unresolved needs.
concepts.identity_rule: Exact snapshot revision plus referenced interpretation/value/source revisions. A separate content fingerprint may support comparison but is not itself semantic equivalence.

fields.name: Selected assertions or bundles
fields.meaning: Actual assertions or attributable provider-data bundles; zero only when the chosen method explicitly requires no external parameter data. Required-but-missing data are unresolved needs, not a parameter-free declaration.
fields.unit_or_basis: Resolved units/conventions; opaque content allowed only with bounded claims.

fields.name: Selection and override precedence
fields.meaning: Deterministic rule selecting alternatives, including user overrides and authorized substitution.
fields.unit_or_basis: Decision provenance, not numerical call order.

fields.name: Material applicability
fields.meaning: Representation or constituent scope for which selections are made.
fields.unit_or_basis: Identity/coordinate revisions.

fields.name: Unresolved needs
fields.meaning: Explicit missing prerequisites for affected operations; resolved here means fixed choices, not universal numerical completeness.
fields.unit_or_basis: Request-specific missing-data descriptors.

fields.name: Approval/trial role
fields.meaning: Approved use, provisional trial or fixed but unqualified selection.
fields.unit_or_basis: Revision linkage and intended use.

invariants: Evaluation cannot re-resolve a moving database entry without a new snapshot.
One incomplete property family need not invalidate independent supported quantities.
A trial snapshot may be fixed and evaluable without being approved production data.
permitted_variants: Limited-property snapshot with explicit unresolved needs.
concepts.lifecycle: Freeze for calculation; new selections create a new revision. P10 commits approved references, not provider caches.
concepts.valid_example: The exact caloric correlations selected for a heater remain available after a source database update.
concepts.invalid_example: Reloading a saved case selects today's default coefficients while labeling the result a reproduction.

concepts.name: Validity and applicability description
concepts.meaning: A qualified statement about the domain of source data, a fitted relationship or a model assumption. It is distinct from numerical solver bounds.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity fixes the subject being qualified, coordinates, domain rule, evidence and status. Unknown coverage is an explicit alternative.

fields.name: Qualified subject
fields.meaning: Datum, parameter group, material characterization or supplied model-applicability statement.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact revision reference or exported subject descriptor.

fields.name: Coordinates and restrictions
fields.meaning: T,P,composition, phase, concentration, species set or other relevant axes and admissible region.
fields.unit_or_basis: Units, closed/open endpoints and chart/basis; domain need not be rectangular.

fields.name: Evidence and confidence of domain
fields.meaning: Measured range, validated envelope, recommended applicability, inferred restriction or unknown coverage.
fields.unit_or_basis: No fabricated uncertainty or global validity.

fields.name: Extrapolation treatment
fields.meaning: Allowed-with-label, forbidden or not assessed for this use; process authorization kept separately.
fields.unit_or_basis: Policy and source of decision.

invariants: A Newton bracket or temperature search limit is not a scientific validity range.
Source measurement range and model validation range may differ and remain separately labeled.
concepts.lifecycle: Add new evidence as a new assessment revision; historical results retain their original qualification.
concepts.valid_example: Coefficients fitted between 300 and 350 K retain that data range even if the numerical routine searches 200–600 K.
concepts.invalid_example: Calling a successful 500 K solve validated because it lies within the solver bounds.

concepts.name: Characterization and fitting recipe
concepts.meaning: The reproducible evidence-to-definition task that generates surrogate constituents or parameter values; it is not a new live material configuration until adopted.
concepts.identity_rule: Recipe revision identifies original evidence, method, discretization/cuts/objective, conventions and requested outputs.

fields.name: Input evidence
fields.meaning: Original assays, curves, light-end information or observations used for the task.
fields.unit_or_basis: Original test/basis conventions preserved.

fields.name: Method and target description
fields.meaning: Characterization/estimation/fitting method, constraints, cut boundaries or objective/residual definitions.
fields.unit_or_basis: All cut axes, objective weights and normalizations declared.

fields.name: Target meaning and parameter needs
fields.meaning: Intended constituent representations and parameter interpretation contracts.
fields.unit_or_basis: No generated numerical fields without semantic meaning.

fields.name: Thermodynamic evaluation requirements
fields.meaning: Exported evaluation descriptors needed by the recipe; execution supplied by coordinator, not a live recursive data lookup.
fields.unit_or_basis: Fixed trial data and conditions required for each evaluation.

fields.name: Output and loss declaration
fields.meaning: Expected proposed constituents/parameters and evidence; retained/lost characterization detail.
fields.unit_or_basis: Assay reconciliation and approximation assumptions.

invariants: A recipe without its raw inputs cannot reconstruct the characterization.
Trial evaluation cannot silently estimate the parameters currently being fitted.
permitted_variants: Fixed empirical correlation selection without a numerical fit.
concepts.lifecycle: Recipe remains fixed within a campaign; changing assumptions starts a distinguishable task revision.
concepts.valid_example: An assay recipe specifies test basis, cut grid and estimation methods and keeps original curve points.
concepts.invalid_example: Saving only generated cut names while claiming the original assay can be reconstructed exactly.

concepts.name: Characterization or fit proposal and trials
concepts.meaning: The candidate outputs and assessment from a preparation campaign, including unsuccessful trials. It packages a coordinated proposal, not permission to mutate approved definitions.
concepts.identity_rule: Campaign/proposal identity plus trial identities and captured recipe/input revisions.

fields.name: Recipe and input snapshot
fields.meaning: Exact task, source evidence and assumptions used.
fields.unit_or_basis: Recipe/data identity.

fields.name: Trials and proposed values
fields.meaning: Candidate parameter/constituent descriptors and evaluation outcomes; zero proposals is valid for a failed campaign.
fields.unit_or_basis: Declared units/bases; no accepted-state implication.

fields.name: Fit/characterization assessment
fields.meaning: Residual/objective values, feasibility, reconciliation, uncertainty if assessed, and unresolved needs.
fields.unit_or_basis: Metric definition, scale and evidence source.

fields.name: Selected proposal
fields.meaning: Explicit proposed coordinated changes and why selected; absent on failure.
fields.unit_or_basis: References to future material/data changes, not a current binding.

fields.name: Evidence lineage
fields.meaning: Sources and execution-evidence references for trial evaluations.
fields.unit_or_basis: Attribution not independent validation.

invariants: Failed trials cannot corrupt selected production data.
Parameter confidence estimates and empirical validation are separate evidence.
A cut identity and its data are proposed together; partial adoption cannot silently leave incompatible references.
permitted_variants: Unsuccessful fit with useful residual diagnostics.
Manual characterized-material proposal with explicit assumptions.
concepts.lifecycle: P02 interprets proposals; P03 qualifies method completeness; P10 commits only domain-approved coordinated revisions.
concepts.valid_example: A rejected fit remains in campaign history while the old approved interaction set stays current.
concepts.invalid_example: A trial optimizer writes directly into every stream's shared interaction table.

concepts.name: Thermodynamic method definition
concepts.meaning: The physical and mathematical meaning of a property, phase, caloric, transport or effective-property method independently of local state and numerical implementation.
concepts.identity_rule: Method identity plus formulation/convention revision. A method family name alone does not establish a complete formula or compatible parameters.

fields.name: Method role and formulation
fields.meaning: EOS, activity, caloric, standard-state, transport, interface, effective closure or an inseparable provider method bundle.
fields.unit_or_basis: Formula or attributable formulation descriptor; no requirement to expose symbolic equations.

fields.name: Input and output meanings
fields.meaning: Required state coordinates, material domains, physical quantities and promised observables.
fields.unit_or_basis: Units/bases and relevant axes; exported semantic descriptions.

fields.name: Parameter obligations
fields.meaning: Required interpretation descriptors; none required for parameter-free relations.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact formula and coefficient conventions.

fields.name: Convention and compatibility needs
fields.meaning: Caloric/chemical/reference and phase-method requirements; dependencies on other methods declared.
fields.unit_or_basis: Convention references, not equal-unit assumptions.

fields.name: Applicability evidence
fields.meaning: Applicable material/domain/conditions and known limits.
fields.unit_or_basis: Scientific validity separate from solver bounds.

invariants: NRTL-like activity behavior and a cubic EOS are different method roles, not interchangeable package labels.
A correlation-based material is not required to expose a thermodynamic potential.
An effective property identifies its closure instead of masquerading as a unique phase property.
permitted_variants: Pinned whole-provider model with limited internal visibility.
concepts.lifecycle: Revise on physical formulation or convention change; selecting another equivalent implementation is separately recorded and qualified.
concepts.valid_example: A vapor fugacity method and liquid activity method state the standard-state relationship needed to use them together.
concepts.invalid_example: Connecting matching function signatures and declaring thermodynamic consistency without convention checks.

concepts.name: Reusable package recipe
concepts.meaning: An engineer-facing selection of thermodynamic methods and preparation rules that may still have unresolved data or defaults.
concepts.identity_rule: Recipe lineage/revision is distinct from each resolved package revision derived from it.

fields.name: Material applicability
fields.meaning: Intended representations or material-selection constraints.
fields.unit_or_basis: Representation identity or explicit admissibility rule.

fields.name: Method selections
fields.meaning: Chosen roles, selectable alternatives or whole-provider bundle choice.
fields.unit_or_basis: Method definitions, not live sessions.

fields.name: Data selection rules
fields.meaning: Sources, overrides, estimation authorization and selection requirements.
fields.unit_or_basis: Rules are not a resolved numerical snapshot.

fields.name: Conventions and physical defaults
fields.meaning: Reference/caloric choices and allowed local specializations.
fields.unit_or_basis: Explicit defaults remain draft until resolved/accepted.

fields.name: Unresolved choices
fields.meaning: Missing selections, conflicts or data needs that prevent specific operations.
fields.unit_or_basis: Resolution status per choice.

invariants: An unresolved recipe cannot be used as if it were an exact reproducible numerical configuration.
A named default becomes a consequential physical choice only when explicitly resolved.
permitted_variants: A parameterized template for several slates.
A whole-engine package choice with pinned bundle requirements.
concepts.lifecycle: Author/edit recipe; resolve into IC-20 with fixed selections. Past IC-20 records are not mutated by later recipe edits.
concepts.valid_example: A conventional gamma–phi recipe leaves binary data selection open until the material slate is known.
concepts.invalid_example: Using the same recipe name as proof that two differently resolved parameter sets are the same package.

concepts.name: Resolved thermodynamic package revision
concepts.meaning: The fixed coherent physical-method/data/reference choices available for use at one or many locations, independent of runtime session state.
concepts.identity_rule: Lineage plus exact revision referencing immutable dependencies. Semantic equivalence across revisions or providers requires an explicit assessment; a hash or shared label is insufficient.

fields.name: Material representation
fields.meaning: Precisely admitted material representation revisions and any permitted mappings.
fields.unit_or_basis: Identity, coordinates and justified bases.

fields.name: Resolved methods
fields.meaning: Actual chosen phase, caloric, transport/effective or whole-bundle methods.
fields.unit_or_basis: No unresolved alternative used implicitly.

fields.name: Resolved data
fields.meaning: Fixed visible parameter snapshot or attributable inseparable bundle.
fields.unit_or_basis: Data revisions and opacity limits.

fields.name: Conventions and eligibility
fields.meaning: Selected energy/standard states and default permitted physical domains/transformations.
fields.unit_or_basis: Definitions, not numerical search settings.

fields.name: Optional chemistry
fields.meaning: Coherent chemical-system definitions where needed.
fields.unit_or_basis: Species and thermochemical compatibility.

fields.name: Compatibility assessments
fields.meaning: Decisions supporting the chosen combinations and explicit unassessed restrictions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Evidence/assessment; resolved does not mean independently validated.

fields.name: Recipe origin
fields.meaning: Source recipe where one was used; direct explicit construction also permitted.
fields.unit_or_basis: Lineage.

invariants: Changing data, material meaning, caloric convention or physical method changes the effective definition.
No local temperature, flow, trial phase amount or mutable native handle is a package definition.
Transport completeness is demand-specific; an unresolved diffusivity does not erase supported enthalpy.
permitted_variants: Whole-provider bundle with bounded disclosed semantics.
concepts.lifecycle: Resolve/freeze and qualify; P10 commits approved references. Local overlays specialize IC-49/IC-35 without silently changing the shared base.
concepts.valid_example: Ten column stages share the same resolved package but retain independent state descriptions.
concepts.invalid_example: Reassigning a native current-stream pointer changes the material that a supposedly immutable package means.

concepts.name: Energy, standard-state and reference convention set
concepts.meaning: The conventions required to interpret and combine caloric, activity, fugacity and chemical-potential quantities. Caloric zero and chemical standard state are separate entries, not one universal reference flag.
concepts.identity_rule: Convention-set revision identifies material/phase scope, temperature/pressure conditions, amount basis, included contributions and transformation evidence.

fields.name: Caloric reference specification
fields.meaning: Enthalpy, entropy and internal-energy references where supported; contributions included or omitted and phase/constituent dependence.
fields.unit_or_basis: Explicit amount basis, reference conditions and reference functions; unsupported members labeled.

fields.name: Chemical standard-state specification
fields.meaning: Required for activity/fugacity/chemical-potential use: standard species/phase/solvent/dilution/pressure convention and definitions of dimensionless ratios.
fields.unit_or_basis: Activities dimensionless under their stated standard; fugacity magnitude and standard pressure distinguished.

fields.name: Formation and reaction accounting
fields.meaning: What formation contribution is already in material energy and what correction the selected balance formulation needs.
fields.unit_or_basis: Per-species/extent conventions; no blanket add-heat-of-reaction rule.

fields.name: Permitted reference transformations
fields.meaning: Evidence-backed transform functions and applicable material/phase range, including composition-dependent corrections.
fields.unit_or_basis: Example H_b=H_a+sum(n_i c_i) for declared molar offsets; no universal scalar assumed.

fields.name: Compatibility evidence
fields.meaning: Why conventions can be combined or transformed; unknown relation remains unknown.
fields.unit_or_basis: Evidence references.

invariants: Identical units do not imply identical energy or chemical standard states.
A reference correction is not a model-error correction or an undeclared heat exchange.
Species-dependent energy shifts that do not cancel through reaction require consistent thermochemical reconciliation.
A mere scalar Cp mixture rule is not necessarily the derivative of an equilibrated material enthalpy.
permitted_variants: Correlation-based caloric methods with explicitly reconciled phase references.
Limited empirical sensible-enthalpy convention with unsupported entropy/chemical potential.
concepts.lifecycle: Revise when selected conventions change; dependent sessions and results require reassessment. Historical values retain their original convention.
concepts.valid_example: Two material models with a known component-wise reference difference report that transformation separately from remaining enthalpy disagreement.
concepts.invalid_example: Changing ionic standard states while leaving equilibrium constants and chemical potentials silently unadjusted.

concepts.name: Physical eligibility and default policy
concepts.meaning: The reusable package's admitted domains, constituents and physical transformations and the local specializations it allows. This declares possibility, not actual phase presence or searched scope.
concepts.identity_rule: Policy revision with constituent/domain eligibility and default semantics; changes to physical restrictions are not merely numerical-policy revisions.

fields.name: Admitted domains and constituents
fields.meaning: Eligible constituent-domain combinations, including candidate solids and fluid categories.
fields.unit_or_basis: Representation/domain references.

fields.name: Default transformation policy
fields.meaning: Phase transfer, chemistry, frozen material and permitted local restrictions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Physical-policy meanings.

fields.name: Allowed local overlays
fields.meaning: Specializations a location/request may apply and conflict-resolution rules.
fields.unit_or_basis: No undocumented evaluation-order precedence.

fields.name: Scope limitations
fields.meaning: Known physical/model limits and explicitly unassessed domains.
fields.unit_or_basis: Not a numerical phase-count guarantee.

invariants: Permitted phases, structurally allocated slots and actually examined candidates are different information.
A physical solid suppression must survive into the effective problem and result lineage.
concepts.lifecycle: Default revision is reusable; local restrictions are retained in the binding/problem rather than altering the original by side effect.
concepts.valid_example: A package admits precipitation, but a deliberately suppressed-solid case records a local restriction.
concepts.invalid_example: A fallback drops the second liquid but reports the original unrestricted phase scope.

concepts.name: Method and convention compatibility assessment
concepts.meaning: The bounded assessment that selected phase, caloric, chemical and effective-property methods can be combined for a declared use.
concepts.identity_rule: Assessment identity captures exact subjects, intended operations, evidence and evaluator/review revision.

fields.name: Assessed subjects
fields.meaning: Methods, data selections, conventions and material scope being combined.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact referenced revisions or immutable exported descriptors.

fields.name: Required relationships
fields.meaning: Conditions such as compatible liquid standard state, complete caloric contribution or consistent species mapping.
fields.unit_or_basis: Explicit relation and intended operation, not generic API compatibility.

fields.name: Per-relationship conclusion
fields.meaning: Compatible under stated assumptions, incompatible, conditionally usable or unassessed, with reasons.
fields.unit_or_basis: Unknown cannot pass a mandatory condition.

fields.name: Evidence and restrictions
fields.meaning: Source data, mathematical checks or prior qualification supporting conclusions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Validity envelope and reference evidence.

invariants: An integration adapter that maps fields does not by itself establish scientific consistency.
A supported phase split alone cannot certify a heater or reactive energy balance.
permitted_variants: Whole-provider coherence assessed as a bundle.
concepts.lifecycle: New subject revisions require a new or explicitly reassessed conclusion. Assessment is not a mutable flag on a method name.
concepts.valid_example: An activity model plus vapor method is qualified only with the necessary vapor-pressure/Henry and caloric conventions.
concepts.invalid_example: A numeric activity vector is deemed compatible with any enthalpy function solely because the units can be converted.

concepts.name: Operation-specific readiness assessment
concepts.meaning: A dependency-aware account of whether a particular physical request can be attempted and what is missing. It aggregates facts from their owners without collapsing them to one package-wide Boolean.
concepts.identity_rule: Assessment identity captures package revision, request descriptor, intended use and attestation/dependency snapshots at assessment time.

fields.name: Package and demand descriptor
fields.meaning: The configured system and immutable description of the demanded operation/output/formulation.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact package and exported operation meaning, not a dependency on a live execution object.

fields.name: Prerequisite categories
fields.meaning: Representation, parameters, compatible methods, calorics, transport, derivatives, dependency availability, algorithm, initializer and process-boundary needs.
fields.unit_or_basis: Each category has satisfied/unsatisfied/unassessed/inapplicable status and reasons.

fields.name: Supporting attestations
fields.meaning: Provider capability, specification and process facts delivered by coordinator in this contract's vocabulary.
fields.unit_or_basis: Provenance and exact subject/build identity; not universal upstream claims.

fields.name: Effective result and limitations
fields.meaning: Eligible to attempt specified operation, blocked or unassessed, including permitted limited operations.
fields.unit_or_basis: Numerical success and independent validation are separate.

fields.name: Dependency fingerprint
fields.meaning: Relevant exact revisions/attestations or conservative captured context for reassessment.
fields.unit_or_basis: No persistent native handle as dependency identity.

invariants: Readiness to attempt is not a promise of convergence.
Initializer failure is not proof of physical infeasibility.
Unavailable optional report data do not block a separate complete primary operation.
permitted_variants: PH blocked by missing ideal caloric contribution.
Equation contribution ready with intentionally unresolved process unknowns.
concepts.lifecycle: Recompute or reassess when a relevant fact changes; expired evidence cannot be made current by relabeling.
concepts.valid_example: Compressor readiness checks the ideal PS reference and the actual outlet operation separately.
concepts.invalid_example: Model construction succeeded, so every downstream unit mode is marked ready.

concepts.name: Local material account
concepts.meaning: The scope of material quantities being described at a location and snapshot: one flowing material, an inventory, an intensive-only description, or a declared reference-amount calculation. Alternative representations of it are not additional material.
concepts.identity_rule: Account identity is local to the host process location and context. Snapshot/revision distinguishes successive descriptions. Cross-unit material transfer relates accounts; it does not require one global conserved object ID.

fields.name: Account purpose
fields.meaning: Flowing material, physical inventory, intensive-only state, or calculation-reference amount.
fields.unit_or_basis: No reference mole amount interpreted as actual equipment inventory.

fields.name: Location/context
fields.meaning: Host location, process scope and optional physical time; reference may be unresolved in a draft only.
fields.unit_or_basis: Opaque host location identity, not graphical coordinates.

fields.name: Authoritative material representation
fields.meaning: Canonical accounting description for this snapshot; other descriptions reference the same account.
fields.unit_or_basis: Representation revision.

fields.name: Totals and partitions
fields.meaning: Known amount/rate totals and disjoint domain/phase portions; undefined amounts remain explicit.
fields.unit_or_basis: Mass/moles/rates/loading totals with stated accounting basis.

fields.name: Alternative views
fields.meaning: Apparent/true/lumped/reporting views and their mappings to the one account.
fields.unit_or_basis: Non-additive view role; no duplicate inventory.

fields.name: Partition/reconciliation rules
fields.meaning: Which portions sum to a total and which overlap or merely report it.
fields.unit_or_basis: Only disjoint portions on compatible bases are summed.

invariants: A material account has one declared total-accounting scope per snapshot, even when many views exist.
Sum leaf portions once; an overall-liquid aggregate is not an extra leaf.
Intensive-only descriptions do not fabricate total energy, mass or flow.
permitted_variants: Unit-mole chemical calculation basis without actual plant inventory.
concepts.lifecycle: Input/candidate snapshots are immutable descriptions; P10 separately establishes currentness. Transfers and time integration generate new snapshots, not silent representation duplication.
concepts.valid_example: Liquid ions and an apparent salt report share one account; the report is excluded from additive totals.
concepts.invalid_example: Adding full mixture mass to phase masses and reporting twice the inventory.

concepts.name: Quantity/value assertion
concepts.meaning: A quantity with its physical meaning, basis, scope, value role and availability. One numeric field plus a unit string is insufficient.
concepts.identity_rule: Assertion identity includes subject/account/snapshot, quantity meaning, role and source. Equivalent display conversions reference the same physical assertion rather than a new experiment.

fields.name: Quantity and subject meaning
fields.meaning: Named observable or amount, exact material/domain/component/pair scope and semantic definition reference or exported descriptor.
fields.unit_or_basis: Scalar/vector/tensor shape and labeled axes; property definition remains P05-owned.

fields.name: Value availability and payload
fields.meaning: Known value, bounded interval, unresolved/deferred, undefined, unavailable, failed or withheld; payload only under an allowed interpretation.
fields.unit_or_basis: Known zero differs from absent data; NaN is not a semantic status.

fields.name: Unit and basis
fields.meaning: Dimension, amount normalization, denominator, scale/offset conversion and applicable reference conditions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Absolute temperature versus temperature difference; mass/molar/specific/total explicit.

fields.name: Role and authority source
fields.meaning: Fixed constraint, observation, guess, inherited default accepted as choice, supplied allocation or calculated value.
fields.unit_or_basis: Role does not follow from numeric magnitude or whether a cell is populated.

fields.name: Conditions and conventions
fields.meaning: Actual evaluation/input conditions, chemical/caloric convention descriptor, domain restrictions and uncertainty evidence where relevant.
fields.unit_or_basis: Reference conditions are not actual conditions.

fields.name: Origin and dependency references
fields.meaning: User/process assertion, measured evidence, derivation or producing calculation plus captured revisions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Lineage; no automatic acceptance or currentness.

invariants: Undefined specific enthalpy of absent material is not a successful zero enthalpy.
Unknown is allowed where the description is partial; required unknown values block completion, not storage.
Units conversion preserves physical intent; basis/reference/model transformation can require more information.
Uncertainty, numerical error and model discrepancy remain distinct qualifications.
permitted_variants: An independently measured value with uncertainty.
Known zero mass flow retaining a separate intended composition.
concepts.lifecycle: New assertion on semantic value/role change; evaluations create derived assertions, not overwrite the originals.
concepts.valid_example: A failed viscosity result carries failed/unavailable status and cannot satisfy a numeric-zero query.
concepts.invalid_example: A previous solved temperature is silently reclassified as the user's fixed outlet specification.

concepts.name: Composition description
concepts.meaning: A set of constituent quantities, fractions or ratios for one account or portion, with explicit basis and independent versus derived values.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity fixes account/portion, snapshot, representation/coordinate revision and assertion role. A permutation of storage does not change physical composition.

fields.name: Account and scope
fields.meaning: Whole material or identified disjoint portion/phase; alternative reporting view explicitly labeled.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exactly one account scope per description.

fields.name: Coordinate system
fields.meaning: Identity/order/chart and normalization denominator of the entries.
fields.unit_or_basis: Mass/molar/rate/concentration/ratio basis.

fields.name: Entries and role
fields.meaning: Known or explicitly unresolved values associated with coordinates; specified/calculated/guess distinctions retained.
fields.unit_or_basis: Uses quantity assertion semantics; no default missing=zero.

fields.name: Total/normalization context
fields.meaning: Known positive denominator or separate total; may be absent for an intensive-only normalized composition specification.
fields.unit_or_basis: Do not infer a composition from zero amounts by division.

fields.name: Relationship to other views
fields.meaning: Map, constraint or chemical reconciliation connecting this description to another of the same material.
fields.unit_or_basis: No new additive inventory.

invariants: Physical accepted fractions are nonnegative and obey the declared normalization within predeclared tolerances.
Amounts may be all zero while intended feed composition is separately known.
A full replacement, a partial patch and total rescaling are different change intents.
permitted_variants: Normalized fraction input with unknown total.
Component flows from which total and fractions are derived.
concepts.lifecycle: Replace/patch/rescale yields a new proposal or snapshot; preserve old role and coordinate lineage.
concepts.valid_example: Changing A from 2 to 4 kg/s while preserving B=3 kg/s yields total 7 and fractions 4/7,3/7.
concepts.invalid_example: Keeping total fixed at 5 while also holding A=4,B=3 without reporting conflicting constraints.

concepts.name: Local state snapshot
concepts.meaning: A time/revision-specific description of material conditions and local domains, possibly partial and not necessarily at phase or chemical equilibrium.
concepts.identity_rule: Snapshot identity fixes account(s), input/context revision and source. Phase instance identities are snapshot-local unless correspondence evidence relates them.

fields.name: Material account
fields.meaning: The local physical or reference-amount scope being described.
fields.unit_or_basis: Flow/inventory/intensive/reference purpose explicit.

fields.name: State-value assertions
fields.meaning: Temperature, pressure, volume, energy and other known or unresolved coordinates with their roles.
fields.unit_or_basis: No universal two-independent-scalars rule.

fields.name: Composition descriptions
fields.meaning: Whole and/or domain-local material descriptions; completeness can be partial.
fields.unit_or_basis: Each description has explicit normalization/account relation.

fields.name: Domain/phase portions
fields.meaning: Present domains plus separately labeled incipient or numerical entries if retained.
fields.unit_or_basis: Presence and quantities explicit; no imposed equilibrium merely from co-location.

fields.name: Additional material attributes
fields.meaning: Distribution or surface realizations appropriate to the representation.
fields.unit_or_basis: Defined attribute and quantity bases.

fields.name: Configuration/time references
fields.meaning: Captured effective material/configuration/binding/time context or explicit unresolved draft references.
fields.unit_or_basis: Physical time distinct from wall-clock solve timestamps.

fields.name: Declared state interpretation
fields.meaning: Equilibrated candidate, supplied nonequilibrium, constrained phase, incomplete input, etc.; this is a claim requiring separate evidence.
fields.unit_or_basis: No accepted/current Boolean embedded as sole quality authority.

invariants: One material account can contain distinct phase temperatures for a declared nonequilibrium formulation.
A populated state is not automatically a completed or accepted state.
No state needs a graphical stream or fictitious flow.
permitted_variants: Separate bulk states plus interface relations.
Inventory U,V specification with unresolved T,P.
concepts.lifecycle: Create captured descriptions; append derived snapshots; acceptance and publication refer to them separately.
concepts.valid_example: A column stage retains guessed temperature, fixed pressure and unresolved composition constraints without claiming a solved stage.
concepts.invalid_example: An interface-property call homogenizes two caller-owned bulk states.

concepts.name: Domain portion and phase instance
concepts.meaning: A physical portion of one local material account or a separately labeled incipient/numerical domain entry. Its identity is not a phase enum index or product port.
concepts.identity_rule: Local snapshot plus domain-entry identity. Physical correspondence across snapshots is a separate IC-30 assertion; unique continuation is not assumed.

fields.name: Parent account and snapshot scope
fields.meaning: Exactly one accounting/snapshot scope for the portion.
fields.unit_or_basis: Disjoint-partition membership or non-additive role declared.

fields.name: Domain definition and candidate origin
fields.meaning: Domain kind plus applicable declared candidate/policy origin.
fields.unit_or_basis: Liquid category does not choose liquid instance identity.

fields.name: Presence and information role
fields.meaning: Present physical, absent physical, incipient limit, numerical placeholder or reporting aggregate prohibited here.
fields.unit_or_basis: Presence evidence/tolerance retained; no rounding destroys conservation.

fields.name: Quantity and composition
fields.meaning: Amount/fraction and composition when physically meaningful; absent phase may retain incipient values only with that role.
fields.unit_or_basis: Fraction denominator and amount basis explicit.

fields.name: Local intensive assertions
fields.meaning: Actual or requested phase T,P,density and other local coordinates.
fields.unit_or_basis: May differ across nonequilibrium portions.

fields.name: Phase-specific species/structure attributes
fields.meaning: Solid form, solution/site or relevant domain descriptors when needed.
fields.unit_or_basis: No phase-specific property inferred from constituent name alone.

invariants: Aggregate mixture and total-liquid views are IC-31, not additional physical phases.
Identical numerical entries need not be two physical phases; amount and role determine interpretation.
A stable-phase claim requires evidence, not just a vapor/liquid label.
permitted_variants: Two liquid instances sharing one liquid method.
Zero-amount incipient vapor carrying continuation information.
concepts.lifecycle: Within-snapshot identity fixed; transitions may create/disappear/merge portions and generate explicit correspondence information.
concepts.valid_example: A zero-amount liquid candidate retains its incipient composition but has no physical outlet mass.
concepts.invalid_example: A separator creates positive product flow because the provider returned a liquid slot.

concepts.name: Cross-snapshot phase correspondence
concepts.meaning: An explicit relation between phase/domain entries in two snapshots, used for comparison or continuation without confusing identity with ordering.
concepts.identity_rule: Correspondence identity fixes source snapshot, target snapshot, relation policy/version and evidence. It never globally renames historical phase entries.

fields.name: Source entries
fields.meaning: Prior phase/domain entries, including none for appearance.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact snapshot-local identities.

fields.name: Target entries
fields.meaning: New entries, including none for disappearance.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact snapshot-local identities.

fields.name: Relation kind
fields.meaning: Continuation, appearance, disappearance, split, merge, relabel/equivalence, ambiguous or unassessed.
fields.unit_or_basis: Many-to-many relation allowed; both sides cannot be empty.

fields.name: Evidence and admissibility
fields.meaning: Representation/domain compatibility, compositions/properties used, phase-policy compatibility and thresholds.
fields.unit_or_basis: Declared criteria; equal density is not sufficient identity evidence.

fields.name: Confidence/ambiguity statement
fields.meaning: Unique under declared criteria, alternatives remain, or no assessed match; numeric score only if its definition exists.
fields.unit_or_basis: No fabricated probabilistic confidence.

invariants: Phase ordering invariance is required, but unique continuity at coalescence is not.
Product-port assignment is a different relation.
A composition basis or constituent-order change must be reconciled before comparing compositions.
permitted_variants: Ambiguous matching after a branch change.
