concepts.lifecycle: Append assessment between immutable snapshots; later policy revisions produce another assessment, not changed old identities.
concepts.valid_example: When two liquids coalesce, both predecessor entries relate to one successor without pretending either survived uniquely.
concepts.invalid_example: Sorting by density renames the phases when densities cross and corrupts a history comparison.

concepts.name: Aggregate and reporting view
concepts.meaning: A derived perspective on existing material, such as overall liquid, dry-gas ratio, standard volume or apparent composition; it is not another physical phase or inventory.
concepts.identity_rule: View identity fixes source snapshots/portions, quantity meaning, basis, transformation/closure and any evaluation dependencies.

fields.name: Sources and selection
fields.meaning: Accounts/portions or property assertions used once according to the view rule.
fields.unit_or_basis: Disjoint or overlapping selection explicit.

fields.name: Reporting meaning and basis
fields.meaning: Observable, wet/dry/solvent/standard-condition convention and denominator.
fields.unit_or_basis: Reference T,P and volume convention when required.

fields.name: Derivation rule
fields.meaning: Algebraic sum/ratio, representation map, effective closure or additional property evaluation.
fields.unit_or_basis: Unit conversion distinguished from reference-state/model calculation.

fields.name: Additional evaluated evidence
fields.meaning: Needed density, standard-state or effective property with captured conventions and source.
fields.unit_or_basis: Missing required evidence leaves the view incomplete.

fields.name: Additivity declaration
fields.meaning: Non-additive alias/view, or a sum over explicitly disjoint physical portions.
fields.unit_or_basis: A view cannot be counted again in its parent account.

invariants: Overall-liquid aggregation does not add another liquid phase.
Standard volume cannot be obtained without the stated reference conditions and required model.
A dry-basis report does not remove actual water from the process material.
concepts.lifecycle: Recompute on changed dependencies; optional view failure leaves an independent accepted primary result intact.
concepts.valid_example: A report shows dry-gas composition while the source account retains its water amount.
concepts.invalid_example: An unavailable reporting density silently changes the material to a different model.

concepts.name: Local distributed-attribute realization
concepts.meaning: A distribution or moment payload attached to a specific amount/portion of material under a defined weighting and support convention.
concepts.identity_rule: Realization identity fixes definition, local association, snapshot, payload and source/reduction lineage.

fields.name: Attribute definition
fields.meaning: Support, measure, weighting and reduction semantics.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact definition revision.

fields.name: Associated material
fields.meaning: Account or portion and actual amount used to weight or convert the attribute.
fields.unit_or_basis: Amount basis must match the weighting measure or have an explicit conversion.

fields.name: Payload and completeness
fields.meaning: Binned weights, density function or finite moments with explicit missing information.
fields.unit_or_basis: Axes, bins and normalization; moments retain their units.

fields.name: Reduction/transfer lineage
fields.meaning: Rebinning, mixing, reduction or selective transfer applied to the original distribution.
fields.unit_or_basis: Information loss and conservation claim explicit.

invariants: One scalar mean cannot be relabeled a full distribution.
Mixing incompatible bins or weighting measures requires a declared transformation.
Selective transfer must state how attribute and material amount change together.
permitted_variants: Full normalized discrete distribution and amount.
concepts.lifecycle: New snapshot on transfer/mix; preserve original payload when available and record all reductions.
concepts.valid_example: 1 kg with mass-bin weights [0.8,0.2] plus 3 kg with [0.2,0.8] gives [0.35,0.65] over identical bins.
concepts.invalid_example: Equal-weight averaging gives [0.5,0.5] and is mislabeled mass-conserving mixing.

concepts.name: Local surface/loading realization
concepts.meaning: The actual nonbulk stored material and loading at a location, separate from bulk material and the process-owned denominator quantity.
concepts.identity_rule: Realization fixes domain/account, basis definition, snapshot and actual supporting denominator context.

fields.name: Basis definition
fields.meaning: Loading/occupancy and amount-conversion meaning.
fields.unit_or_basis: Area, dry mass, sites or other explicit denominator.

fields.name: Local account and domain
fields.meaning: Surface/nonbulk portion being described.
fields.unit_or_basis: Separate accounting portion, not fictitious flowing liquid.

fields.name: Denominator and loading
fields.meaning: Known or unresolved actual denominator and supported loading quantities.
fields.unit_or_basis: Units and dry/wet or excess/total convention retained.

fields.name: Stored material and site account
fields.meaning: Derived or supplied species amounts and occupied/vacant sites where meaningful.
fields.unit_or_basis: Justified conserved basis and occupancy checks.

fields.name: Exchange links
fields.meaning: Transfers relating loading changes to bulk or reservoir quantities.
fields.unit_or_basis: Signed amount/rate and interval explicit.

invariants: Unknown denominator permits an intensive loading description but not a unique total amount.
Bulk and adsorbed material are disjoint portions only under an explicit accounting convention.
permitted_variants: Reference-only interface description without a physical stored amount.
concepts.lifecycle: Update through new transfer/state proposals; site capacity and equilibrium support are separately qualified.
concepts.valid_example: An authorized 0.1 mol transfer from bulk adds 0.1 mol to the supported total adsorbed amount.
concepts.invalid_example: Increasing loading without decreasing any source or declaring an external exchange.

concepts.name: Operation contract
concepts.meaning: The reusable meaning of a property, state-resolution, phase/chemical-equilibrium, stability, derivative or coupled-contribution operation. It is not a provider method signature.
concepts.identity_rule: Contract revision identifies admissible inputs, authority pattern, output meanings and promised completion level.

fields.name: Operation purpose
fields.meaning: Property-only, TP/PH/PS/saturation, phase/chemical equilibrium, stability, restricted branch, derivative or mathematical contribution.
fields.unit_or_basis: Physical intent and specification meanings.

fields.name: Input and authority obligations
fields.meaning: Required known quantities, permissible unresolved coordinates and transformations; reference-amount requirements when applicable.
fields.unit_or_basis: Quantity/basis conventions, not a fixed two-scalar interface.

fields.name: Output demands
fields.meaning: Observable/result semantics with mandatory, conditional or optional role and domain/pair/component scope.
fields.unit_or_basis: Demand conditionality and completeness promise explicit.

fields.name: Required postconditions
fields.meaning: What completing the operation establishes and what it does not establish.
fields.unit_or_basis: Residual/authority/check definitions, no implied all-properties-computed promise.

fields.name: Physical eligibility
fields.meaning: Supported material and transformation scope as contract criteria.
fields.unit_or_basis: Declared phase/species/branch restrictions.

invariants: A phase-property operation may resolve permitted density without gaining authority to redistribute species.
Equilibrium output does not imply every transport property is available.
An upstream capability name is not proof the chosen adapter realizes the contract.
concepts.lifecycle: Contracts are versioned definitions; submitted instances are IC-35.
concepts.valid_example: A PH contract requires verified target enthalpy and declared phase scope but requests viscosity only optionally.
concepts.invalid_example: A function named flash is treated as supporting every input pair and number of phases.

concepts.name: Physical calculation problem
concepts.meaning: The captured physical question at a location: original data, constraints, unknowns, transformation permissions, output demands and check scope. It survives algorithm changes intact.
concepts.identity_rule: Problem identity fixes captured physical inputs, package/binding revisions, conventions, local restrictions and desired completion. Attempts and initial guesses are separate identities.

fields.name: Operation contract
fields.meaning: Exact physical operation being instantiated.
fields.unit_or_basis: Contract revision.

fields.name: Material inputs
fields.meaning: Captured local state/account descriptions with required composition/amount context.
fields.unit_or_basis: Specified versus guessed quantities retain roles.

fields.name: Effective configuration
fields.meaning: Base package and resolved local binding/overlay facts.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact references or immutable exported descriptors; not ambient state.

fields.name: Constraints and authority
fields.meaning: Original specified quantities, coupled unknowns and permissions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Constraint and quantity-family semantics.

fields.name: Restrictions and coupling
fields.meaning: Phase/chemistry constraints, requested branch, reservoir permissions and declared splitting approximation.
fields.unit_or_basis: A changed physical scope creates a distinct problem.

fields.name: Outputs and checks
fields.meaning: Required/optional observable/contribution demands and acceptance criteria.
fields.unit_or_basis: Explicit scope and tolerance definitions.

fields.name: Captured context
fields.meaning: Model/dependency revision, process scope and original request provenance supplied as reference values.
fields.unit_or_basis: No mutable P10 service dependency required to define meaning.

invariants: Numerical retries refer to the original target; they do not redefine it to the returned value.
An authorized alternative with different phases/species/model has a new problem and a relation to the original.
Total U,V need justified amounts/composition for a complete inventory-state problem.
concepts.lifecycle: Freeze original problem; create separately identified attempts, alternatives, candidate results and assessments.
concepts.valid_example: An accepted solid-suppressed alternative is linked to, but not mislabeled as, the unrestricted request.
concepts.invalid_example: A fallback modifies the requested candidate-phase list in place then reports same-problem convergence.

concepts.name: Specification, constraint and unknown set
concepts.meaning: The joint constraints that define a local state or contribution and the quantities left unknown. It distinguishes constraint role from the mere presence of a value.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity fixes variable coordinates, constraint definitions, input roles, intended standalone/coupled completion and assessed independence.

fields.name: Quantity/variable bindings
fields.meaning: Local observables or algebraic coordinates and their subject/domain identity.
fields.unit_or_basis: Units, basis, composition chart and scale per coordinate.

fields.name: Constraint statements
fields.meaning: Equalities, inequalities, ranges or fixed-value specifications and their origin.
fields.unit_or_basis: Redundant observations can be checks rather than added equations.

fields.name: Unknowns and held-fixed quantities
fields.meaning: Explicit unknown and fixed sets, including relationship to external coupled variables.
fields.unit_or_basis: No silent freezing from old values.

fields.name: Completeness assessment
fields.meaning: Intentionally partial, sufficient, under/over-specified, inconsistent or unassessed with evidence.
fields.unit_or_basis: Counting values alone is not a rank or feasibility proof.

fields.name: Observations/initial estimates
fields.meaning: Values retained with non-constraint roles unless explicitly selected.
fields.unit_or_basis: Measurement uncertainty and guesses remain different.

invariants: Pure-fluid saturated T,P may be dependent and leave phase allocation undetermined.
A partially specified coupled stage is a legitimate description, not an automatic error.
Nonlinear rank/uniqueness must remain unassessed when not established.
permitted_variants: Balance/equilibrium constraints jointly solved with unit equations.
Range-constrained or overdetermined observations requiring explicit reconciliation.
concepts.lifecycle: Original set preserved through numerical preparation; any temporary fixing is separately recorded and reversed or explicitly reconciled.
concepts.valid_example: A temperature measurement can be a validation observation while the process solver determines temperature from PH.
concepts.invalid_example: A guess is left fixed after initialization and silently adds an extra physical constraint.

concepts.name: Calculation-authority allocation
concepts.meaning: Who supplied each relevant quantity and which operation may determine or change it. Numerical ownership of a buffer is not physical authority.
concepts.identity_rule: Authority identity fixes the problem, quantity families, source assertions and permitted changes at the requested scope.

fields.name: Quantity scopes
fields.meaning: Intensive coordinates, constituent totals, phase amounts/compositions, total amount, external exchanges or distributed attributes.
fields.unit_or_basis: Component/domain/phase and amount basis explicit.

fields.name: Original authority
fields.meaning: User specification, unit balance, external accepted allocation, chemical-system constraints or unresolved variable ownership.
fields.unit_or_basis: Provenance of fixed quantities.

fields.name: Permitted determinations
fields.meaning: Evaluate properties, resolve density/root, redistribute phases, transform species, or apply explicitly approved map.
fields.unit_or_basis: Permissions are not inferred from provider capability.

fields.name: Preservation obligations
fields.meaning: Quantities/relations that must remain unchanged, and observational checks.
fields.unit_or_basis: Structural equality or declared numerical tolerance as appropriate.

fields.name: Conflict assessment
fields.meaning: Compatible, conflicting or unassessed allocation with reasons.
fields.unit_or_basis: Unavailable evidence is not implicit consent.

invariants: Fixing an arbitrary split and requiring unrestricted equilibrium can conflict.
Phase redistribution does not authorize chemical reaction.
Permission to calculate does not authorize publishing a current result.
permitted_variants: Element-conserving chemical equilibrium with explicitly allowed reservoirs.
concepts.lifecycle: Attached to a fixed problem; physical changes create a new authority record and problem identity.
concepts.valid_example: An externally supplied phase split is preserved during an enthalpy refresh.
concepts.invalid_example: A property evaluator consumes a frozen species because the external engine equilibrates by default.

concepts.name: Property observable definition
concepts.meaning: The exact property being requested: physical subject, mathematical meaning, domain, basis and conventions. Same labels or units do not establish equality of observables.
concepts.identity_rule: Observable revision fixes subject kind, definition, normalization, references and response semantics. Local numeric assertions use this meaning but do not own it.

fields.name: Property meaning
fields.meaning: Defined scalar/vector/tensor quantity, including intrinsic, additive aggregate, effective closure or diagnostic role.
fields.unit_or_basis: Dimensions and labeled axes.

fields.name: Subject scope
fields.meaning: Whole material, phase/domain, component-in-phase, partial molar subject, ordered transfer pair or unordered interfacial pair.
fields.unit_or_basis: A pair is ordered only when the observable's direction requires it.

fields.name: Amount and denominator basis
fields.meaning: Total, molar, mass-specific, concentration, per-carrier/site/area or other justified basis.
fields.unit_or_basis: Extensive totals require a material amount; reference amount is explicit.

fields.name: Reference and standard conventions
fields.meaning: Energy, activity, fugacity, standard volume or other required conventions.
fields.unit_or_basis: No free-floating h,mu,pH or standard volume without its necessary context.

fields.name: Definition/closure dependencies
fields.meaning: Underlying methods or effective-property assumptions and required phase inputs.
fields.unit_or_basis: Frozen-allocation aggregate versus equilibrium response distinguished.

fields.name: Tensor/component axes
fields.meaning: Required for vector/tensor transport and partial-molar quantities, including diffusion frame/reference species when applicable.
fields.unit_or_basis: Axes, coordinate basis and constitutive sign convention.

invariants: Viscosity is not a heat-transfer coefficient.
A total energy and a molar energy differ even if a provider names both enthalpy.
An equilibrium-response heat capacity is not replaced by a weighted frozen-phase value.
A chemical potential standard convention must be compatible with the equilibrium residual in which it is used.
permitted_variants: Liquid–liquid interfacial tension for a named pair.
Composition-chart diffusion matrix in a declared flux frame.
concepts.lifecycle: Define reusable meaning; local requested scope instantiates it without changing its mathematical interpretation.
concepts.valid_example: Two reported Cp values have distinct definitions: fixed phase allocation and re-equilibrated total response.
concepts.invalid_example: Both use kJ/kg/K, so they are treated as numerically interchangeable.

concepts.name: Derivative and solved-response specification
concepts.meaning: The meaning of a derivative, including output/input coordinates, constraints held fixed, allowed phase/chemical response, derivative order and coordinate transformations.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity is the complete derivative experiment, not merely a variable pair. Changes of independent chart or equilibrium response create a different observable.

fields.name: Output observable and input chart
fields.meaning: What is differentiated and with respect to which independent state/parameter/amount coordinates.
fields.unit_or_basis: Output units divided by input units for first derivatives; explicit tensor axes for higher order.

fields.name: Held-fixed conditions
fields.meaning: Pressure, composition, amount, phase fractions, parameters or other constraints held fixed in this derivative.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact quantity/domain conventions.

fields.name: Response mode
fields.meaning: Local homogeneous, fixed allocation, saturation path, constrained re-equilibrium, chemical response, parameter sensitivity or declared other path.
fields.unit_or_basis: No inference from a generic automatic-differentiation flag.

fields.name: Order and orientation
fields.meaning: First/higher/mixed order, full or directional derivative, tensor index order and normalization.
fields.unit_or_basis: Composition chart and direction must obey the specified constraints.

fields.name: Branch and validity demands
fields.meaning: Active branch, one-sided/two-sided expectation, transition restrictions and conditioning checks requested.
fields.unit_or_basis: Nonexistence, ambiguity and not-assessed smoothness remain separate.

fields.name: Coordinate/chain-rule relation
fields.meaning: Transformations needed to compare derivative coordinates, including parameter reference changes.
fields.unit_or_basis: Explicit Jacobian/chart conventions, not just unit conversion.

invariants: N normalized fractions do not define N independent directions without a constraint convention.
Derivative of an equation residual differs from total sensitivity of a solved constrained state.
The method used to obtain a derivative belongs to execution evidence; it does not define what derivative was requested.
permitted_variants: Local d h/dT at fixed P,x.
PH-flash temperature sensitivity to total feed composition in an N−1 chart.
Second derivative or directional sensitivity with explicit available evidence.
concepts.lifecycle: Frozen request semantics; each computed tensor is a candidate carrying actual method, branch and verification evidence.
concepts.valid_example: An equilibrium enthalpy response explicitly allows phase fractions and compositions to change with temperature.
concepts.invalid_example: A homogeneous derivative is returned for a perturbation that crosses a phase transition without qualification.

concepts.name: Mathematical contribution description
concepts.meaning: The local thermodynamic relationships supplied to a coupled unit/process formulation without imposing one solver, symbolic language or global equation graph.
concepts.identity_rule: Contribution revision fixes local variable roles, relationships, external mappings and supported value/residual/equation/derivative semantics.

fields.name: Local variables and bindings
fields.meaning: Local coordinates mapped explicitly to host problem variables or fixed parameters.
fields.unit_or_basis: Units, bases, composition charts and scale meanings.

fields.name: Relationships and contribution kind
fields.meaning: Values, residuals, equations, inequalities or qualified callbacks actually provided.
fields.unit_or_basis: Equation semantics and residual normalization; no required syntax/IR.

fields.name: Physical responsibility boundary
fields.meaning: What the contribution enforces versus unit/host balances and unknowns it only consumes.
fields.unit_or_basis: No duplicate independent enforcement of already fixed quantities.

fields.name: Derivative dependencies and pattern
fields.meaning: Actually available Jacobian/Hessian/directional information and structural versus state-observed dependence.
fields.unit_or_basis: A numerical zero is not proof of structural independence.

fields.name: Bounds and scaling descriptors
fields.meaning: Physical admissibility, numerical search bounds and scaling as separately identified facts.
fields.unit_or_basis: Original physical units recoverable; scaling does not redefine a constraint.

fields.name: Initialization interventions
fields.meaning: Temporary fixing, relaxed constraints, branch seeds and restoration/evidence obligations.
fields.unit_or_basis: Original problem remains retained; reversible interventions have explicit scope.

invariants: A value callback does not imply symbolic equations or derivatives.
Temporary fixed variables must be restored or explicitly reconciled before acceptance of the original formulation.
Structural phase candidates for an equation model do not certify all of them are physically present.
permitted_variants: Residual callback with analytical or qualified numerical derivatives.
Opaque value evaluator in a supported host formulation.
concepts.lifecycle: Bound to captured model construction; changes to equations or coordinate bindings require reassessment before state restoration.
concepts.valid_example: A stage contribution supplies phase enthalpies and equilibrium relations while the column owns interstage balances.
concepts.invalid_example: The property block and host independently prescribe conflicting phase fractions.

concepts.name: Postcondition and check obligation
concepts.meaning: The required evidence for a calculation to meet its claimed scope: targets, conservation, authority, phase/chemical conditions or derivative correctness.
concepts.identity_rule: Check identity fixes the original subject/request, mathematical criterion, tolerance/scale policy and mandatory/optional applicability.

fields.name: Criterion and target
fields.meaning: Original observable or relationship to test, including conservation and authority invariants.
fields.unit_or_basis: Reference target captured before solving; not replaced by candidate.

fields.name: Scope and applicability
fields.meaning: Property, equilibrium, stage, unit or flowsheet scope; mandatory, conditional or optional role.
fields.unit_or_basis: Condition under which the check becomes required.

fields.name: Residual definition
fields.meaning: How input/candidate/exchange values form the physical residual, independent of solver success.
fields.unit_or_basis: Declared sign, dimensions and reference convention.

fields.name: Tolerance and scale policy
fields.meaning: Predeclared absolute/relative criteria, scale definition, floor and zero-scale behavior.
fields.unit_or_basis: No universal accuracy percentage; gross scales for cancellation-prone balances.

fields.name: Evidence needed
fields.meaning: Required candidate fields, evaluations, reference observations or process residuals.
fields.unit_or_basis: Same-model reevaluation distinguished from independent reference evidence.

fields.name: Unavailable-evidence outcome
fields.meaning: Mandatory unknown blocks that scope; optional unknown remains explicitly unassessed.
fields.unit_or_basis: Not-assessed is not pass.

invariants: A local flash check cannot certify a whole recycle.
A small step size does not replace a target-residual check.
No check may silently adjust an original constraint or add a reservoir to pass.
permitted_variants: Independent validation against a bounded datum set.
concepts.lifecycle: Defined with original problem or qualification plan; assessment results live in IC-59.
concepts.valid_example: A result reporting solver success with h=20 against target 50 fails the original enthalpy criterion.
concepts.invalid_example: Changing the target to 20 after the solve and declaring zero residual.

concepts.name: Effective physical restriction and branch request
concepts.meaning: The actual local restrictions and branch expectations of a problem, distinct from reusable package defaults, numerical starting guesses, and phases an algorithm happened to inspect.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity fixes all effective restrictions, rationale and branch meaning under an exact base policy revision.

fields.name: Base eligibility
fields.meaning: Physical candidates/default policies being specialized.
fields.unit_or_basis: Policy revision.

fields.name: Restrictions and permissions
fields.meaning: Excluded phases, suppressed reactions, frozen constituents, allowed exchanges and other actual physical limits.
fields.unit_or_basis: Scope and rationale for every specialization.

fields.name: Requested branch
fields.meaning: Stable, constrained, metastable or explicitly specified continuation branch; absence means use declared default policy, not arbitrary root.
fields.unit_or_basis: A branch seed alone is not a physical restriction.

fields.name: Structural/physical candidate distinction
fields.meaning: What the formulation allocates versus what the physical problem admits.
fields.unit_or_basis: Numerical examined set reported separately in execution evidence.

fields.name: Claim limitations
fields.meaning: What equilibrium/stability claims remain admissible under these restrictions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Unrestricted stability not inferred from constrained success.

invariants: Changing restrictions changes the effective physical problem even if the reusable package is unchanged.
An imposed phase can be unsupported or physically inadmissible and must not guarantee success.
permitted_variants: Inert transported solids excluded from equilibrium.
Solid suppression with a constrained-fluid branch.
concepts.lifecycle: Captured per problem; lifting suppression creates a new problem and invalidates applicability of the restricted result to it.
concepts.valid_example: A suppressed-solid value is retained as restricted history when unrestricted precipitation is later enabled.
concepts.invalid_example: A constrained liquid root is labeled a globally stable equilibrium without assessing allowed competitors.

concepts.name: Reaction identity and stoichiometry
concepts.meaning: The chemical transformation and extent convention, independently of the kinetic law, equilibrium closure, reactor geometry and local achieved conversion.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity fixes species roles, normalized stoichiometry, phase conventions and extent normalization. Rescaling coefficients changes extent coordinates unless mapped explicitly.

fields.name: Species and stoichiometric coefficients
fields.meaning: Reactant/product signs, identities and phase-specific species meanings when needed.
fields.unit_or_basis: Moles of species per unit defined reaction extent or another explicit justified basis.

fields.name: Extent/base-reactant convention
fields.meaning: Normalization and relation between extent, specified conversion and selected base reactant.
fields.unit_or_basis: Extent or rate units explicit; molecular total moles need not be conserved.

fields.name: Conserved-basis qualification
fields.meaning: Which balances stoichiometry satisfies and which remain unjustified.
fields.unit_or_basis: For a linear species basis, A nu=0 for each claimed closed conserved row.

fields.name: Reference/property requirements
fields.meaning: Formation/standard-state data and energy correction requirements exported for package compatibility.
fields.unit_or_basis: No independent unconditional addition of reaction heat.

invariants: Unbalanced asserted chemistry is rejected or unresolved for that claim, not repaired by normalization.
Strict conversion feasibility is checked before adoption; clipping negative amounts is not the same request.
permitted_variants: Reaction set component used by equilibrium or rate laws.
concepts.lifecycle: Revision when chemistry or extent convention changes; residence time changes do not change this identity.
concepts.valid_example: For A→B and one mole A available, extent 0.4 leaves 0.6 A,0.4 B; strict extent 1.2 is infeasible.
concepts.invalid_example: Treating a limited extent of one as successful fulfillment of a strict requested extent of 1.2.

concepts.name: Reaction-law and thermochemical requirement
concepts.meaning: The relationship used for a declared reaction: specified conversion, equilibrium relation or finite-rate law, with its independent variables and normalization.
concepts.identity_rule: Law identity fixes reaction revision, mathematical meaning, input standard states/bases and parameter interpretations.

fields.name: Reaction target
fields.meaning: Reaction(s) or coherent chemical relation to which the law applies.
fields.unit_or_basis: Stoichiometry and extent normalization.

fields.name: Law kind and relationship
fields.meaning: Specified extent/conversion constraint, equilibrium constant relation or kinetic expression.
fields.unit_or_basis: Dimensionless equilibrium convention or explicit dimensional law basis.

fields.name: Input/property requirements
fields.meaning: Activities, fugacities, concentrations, temperature and other requested quantities as exported semantic meanings.
fields.unit_or_basis: Concentration frame, solvent basis, standard pressure, activity definition as applicable.

fields.name: Parameters and applicability
fields.meaning: Rate/equilibrium coefficients with exact equation units and source range.
fields.unit_or_basis: Ordered coefficients and thermochemical interpretation.

fields.name: Rate normalization
fields.meaning: Required for kinetics: per volume, catalyst mass, area or other denominator and relation to process totals.
fields.unit_or_basis: Local rate versus total extent rate distinguished.

invariants: A reaction rate per kg catalyst is not automatically per reactor volume.
Reaction order need not be inferred from stoichiometric coefficient.
A finite-rate law cannot be replaced by equilibrium because only equilibrium is available.
permitted_variants: Kinetic law with explicit catalyst/site normalization.
concepts.lifecycle: Used as reusable definition; local rates/extent values are quantity assertions in a captured problem/result.
concepts.valid_example: The same kinetic law can be evaluated at several reactor locations without owning reactor residence time.
concepts.invalid_example: A rate formula expecting molarity receives mole fractions with no conversion.

concepts.name: Chemical system and participation description
concepts.meaning: The coherent species/reaction domain and participation assumptions needed for property, reactive equilibrium, or kinetic/equilibrium calculations.
concepts.identity_rule: Chemical-system revision fixes species meanings, data, admissible reactions/domains, conserved basis and participation rules. Local specialized restrictions remain captured in the problem.

fields.name: Species and representations
fields.meaning: Permitted true species and any apparent representation relationships.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact identities; zero-feed products remain possible if eligible.

fields.name: Reaction/law and data set
fields.meaning: Explicit reactions/laws or a database-based chemical-potential system without an enumerated reaction list.
fields.unit_or_basis: Thermochemical data/conventions kept coherent.

fields.name: Domain/participation rules
fields.meaning: Equilibrated, kinetic, frozen, inert or excluded species/reactions in their domains.
fields.unit_or_basis: Frozen species, frozen phase allocation and zero initial amount are different.

fields.name: Conserved quantities
fields.meaning: Totals constrained in closed or explicitly open chemical problems.
fields.unit_or_basis: Element/mass/charge/sites only where justified.

fields.name: Exchange requirements
fields.meaning: Allowed-to-be-requested reservoirs/titrants and their implications; unit must authorize actual exchange.
fields.unit_or_basis: Open-system definitions.

invariants: One coupled problem may resolve chemistry and phases simultaneously.
A fixed-species VLE flash is not chemical equilibration.
Choosing fewer species is an explicit model restriction, not just a faster equivalent solve.
concepts.lifecycle: P06 owns chemistry meaning; P03 reconciles selected calorics; actual problems and solves reference a fixed revision.
concepts.valid_example: A kinetic mineral can coexist with an equilibrated aqueous subset without forcing mineral equilibrium.
concepts.invalid_example: A solver adds a new possible product species in a retry without changing the problem identity.

concepts.name: Reservoir and chemical-exchange requirement
concepts.meaning: The material/energy exchange semantics required by a chemical constraint, not a silent license for the numerical provider to introduce matter.
concepts.identity_rule: Requirement identity fixes reservoir/substance, imposed condition, allowed exchange coordinates and reference convention.

fields.name: Reservoir/substance identity
fields.meaning: External gas, titrant, component source/sink, electron or other explicitly modeled reservoir meaning.
fields.unit_or_basis: Composition/charge/energy conventions where justified.

fields.name: Imposed chemical condition
fields.meaning: Target pH/fugacity/other constrained chemical condition and its convention.
fields.unit_or_basis: Condition meaning and standard state are explicit.

fields.name: Exchange dimensions and bounds
fields.meaning: Permitted amount/rate, direction and bounds; closed boundary is a distinct prohibition.
fields.unit_or_basis: Sign convention relative to the material account.

fields.name: Caloric/accounting requirements
fields.meaning: Data required to include the exchange in a process balance; unknown energy blocks an energy-balanced claim where necessary.
fields.unit_or_basis: No heat double counting or unreported substance addition.

fields.name: Process authorization needed
fields.meaning: Which local process choice must permit the reservoir and capacity before solving.
fields.unit_or_basis: Requirement does not grant permission by itself.

invariants: An imposed chemical condition can be infeasible under a closed boundary; hidden exchange is prohibited.
Every used exchange must appear as IC-71 in the candidate account and balance evidence.
permitted_variants: Gas reservoir exchange under fugacity constraint.
No exchange permitted for a closed system.
concepts.lifecycle: Definition is reusable; permitted actual exchange and its realization belong to a captured local problem and result.
concepts.valid_example: A pH-controlled case reports the titrant quantity and its relevant energy contribution.
concepts.invalid_example: A closed-system solver satisfies a gas condition by unreported gas addition.

concepts.name: Apparent/true-species reconciliation
concepts.meaning: The chemistry-aware relation between feed/reporting components and true species of the same material. It may require solving and may have a nonunique reverse attribution.
concepts.identity_rule: Reconciliation revision captures both representations, conserved mappings, chemical conventions and any reporting attribution rules.

fields.name: Source/target descriptions
fields.meaning: Apparent and true representations and applicable coordinate maps.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact revisions and amount bases.

fields.name: Shared conserved account
fields.meaning: Relations that ensure both descriptions denote the same underlying material totals.
fields.unit_or_basis: Element/mass/charge conventions justified for this system.

fields.name: Chemical constraints
fields.meaning: Speciation or reaction conditions required to determine the true species; empty only for a justified direct map.
fields.unit_or_basis: Chemical system and participation requirements.

fields.name: Reverse reporting rule
fields.meaning: Unique mapping, constrained attribution, convention-dependent reporting or unavailable inverse.
fields.unit_or_basis: Any assumed association is reported as a convention, not observed molecules.

fields.name: No-duplicate-inventory rule
fields.meaning: Which actual material account is represented and how aliases/views are excluded from additive balances.
fields.unit_or_basis: One physical account, multiple descriptive views.

invariants: Apparent salt plus its represented ions must not be summed as distinct inventory.
Preserving element totals does not generally choose a unique apparent-species attribution.
State-dependent speciation is not mislabeled a constant permutation matrix.
permitted_variants: Feed formula-to-element totals followed by speciation.
Direct known species relabeling where genuinely equivalent.
concepts.lifecycle: Revise when chemical/reporting interpretation changes; applications retain exact state and assumption lineage.
concepts.valid_example: One mol apparent NaCl represented as one mol Na+ and one mol Cl− preserves elements/charge accounting but not molecular mole count.
concepts.invalid_example: The report counts one mol NaCl plus both ions as additional physical matter.

concepts.name: Process location and region description
concepts.meaning: The named place in the host process model where thermodynamic material information is used: stream endpoint, stage, segment, bulk/interface, inventory or other domain.
concepts.identity_rule: Host location identity plus structural revision and role. A graphical label or screen position is not physical identity.

fields.name: Host object and local role
fields.meaning: Unit/connection reference plus stage, segment, side, interface or inventory designation.
fields.unit_or_basis: Opaque host identity; geometry remains host-owned.

fields.name: Location hierarchy
fields.meaning: Parent region/location and declared inheritance context; root has no parent.
fields.unit_or_basis: Hierarchy used for binding resolution, not solver order.

fields.name: Material-domain meaning
fields.meaning: Applicable representation/domain description and quantity purpose.
fields.unit_or_basis: No implicit flow for inventories or interfaces.

fields.name: Time association
fields.meaning: Physical time/slice if relevant; absent for a steady state; distinct from execution timestamps.
fields.unit_or_basis: Time origin and units explicit where values are supplied.

fields.name: Interfaces/couplings
fields.meaning: Other locations to which heat, material or constitutive relationships connect.
fields.unit_or_basis: Coupling kind explicit.

invariants: Two exchanger sides remain different material locations.
Internal states do not require graphical stream objects.
A location parent hierarchy cannot contain an unexplained inheritance cycle.
concepts.lifecycle: Host owns topology; changes to relevant structure trigger new bindings/problems and dependency reassessment.
concepts.valid_example: COLUMN-1/stage-3/vapor is a stable local role independent of icon position.
concepts.invalid_example: Moving an icon changes its thermodynamic region or material identity.

concepts.name: Effective thermodynamic location binding
concepts.meaning: The resolved thermodynamic assignment for a location after explicit defaults, inheritance and permitted local specialization have been applied.
concepts.identity_rule: Binding revision fixes location, base package, local physical overlays and resolution trace; no dependence on order of evaluations.

fields.name: Location
fields.meaning: The process location/region to which the binding applies.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact structural context.

fields.name: Base resolved package
fields.meaning: Reusable coherent package applied at this location.
fields.unit_or_basis: Package revision.

fields.name: Local overlays
fields.meaning: Permitted phase/chemistry/branch specialization and reporting references.
fields.unit_or_basis: Physical effect and source of override explicitly recorded.

fields.name: Resolution trace
fields.meaning: Explicit assignment versus inherited/default choices, precedence and conflict resolution.
fields.unit_or_basis: No last-used-session rule.

fields.name: Boundary compatibility needs
fields.meaning: Neighboring material bindings requiring translation or separate heat-only treatment.
fields.unit_or_basis: Identity/reference/operation prerequisites.

invariants: Ambiguous inheritance blocks affected calculation rather than choosing the latest used package.
Changing a local restriction changes effective problem meaning without necessarily editing the shared package.
concepts.lifecycle: P07 resolves proposals; P10 commits binding revision and invalidates affected contexts.
concepts.valid_example: Two exchanger sides use different packages throughout interleaved calls.
concepts.invalid_example: A stage accidentally uses the package left active by the previous stage.

concepts.name: Unit demands, coupling and routing declaration
concepts.meaning: The thermodynamic boundary of an equipment/process formulation: required properties, balance constraints, material/heat transfer and product allocation rules.
concepts.identity_rule: Declaration revision fixes unit mode, relevant locations, assumptions and completion hierarchy; it does not own global solver implementation.

fields.name: Unit mode and locations
fields.meaning: Selected physical formulation and participating input/internal/output locations.
fields.unit_or_basis: Unit-owned geometry referenced only as needed for input semantics.

fields.name: Property/contribution demands
fields.meaning: Mandatory and optional local properties, derivatives or equations needed by that mode.
fields.unit_or_basis: Demand scope and conditionality retained.

fields.name: Balance and operating constraints
fields.meaning: Pressure/temperature/heat/work/efficiency and local coupling relations supplied by unit.
fields.unit_or_basis: Signs, bases, required physical assumptions explicit.

fields.name: Product-routing and transfer rules
fields.meaning: Mechanical split, phase routing, entrainment/carryover, or interfacial transfer convention.
fields.unit_or_basis: Port roles differ from phase identities; geometry-dependent closures remain unit-owned.

fields.name: Completion and check scope
fields.meaning: Required local/unit/flowsheet conditions and which candidate set must be consistent.
fields.unit_or_basis: No local-success implication for parent scope.

invariants: A duty-only heater is a different demand from its rating mode.
A separator routes evaluated phases under named assumptions rather than making ports physical phase identities.
A heat-only connection does not perform constituent translation.
permitted_variants: Rate-based contactor with distinct bulk/interface states.
concepts.lifecycle: Changes in formulation or physical rules produce new declarations and affected problems; display-only edits do not.
concepts.valid_example: Transport data become mandatory for exchanger rating while enthalpy-only duty remains separately supported.
concepts.invalid_example: Ignoring missing viscosity and presenting duty-only results as completed rating.

concepts.name: Material-boundary translation case
concepts.meaning: An application of representation and convention mappings between particular source and target process descriptions under explicitly preserved constraints.
concepts.identity_rule: Translation-case identity captures source/target binding/snapshot, map revisions, chosen preserved quantities and authorized physical exchanges.

fields.name: Source and target binding
fields.meaning: Both sides of the material boundary.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact effective package/representation context.

fields.name: Source material and representation map
fields.meaning: Actual source snapshot and applicable map, including any chemical/reporting reconciliation.
fields.unit_or_basis: Conserved bases and information-loss statement.

fields.name: Reference transformation
fields.meaning: Known energy/standard-state relation required for the requested preservation; absent relation means unassessed/incomplete where needed.
fields.unit_or_basis: May depend on composition/domain; no guessed universal offset.

fields.name: Preserved quantities and target problem
fields.meaning: T,P,composition or P,corrected-H,etc. as a jointly admissible set.
fields.unit_or_basis: Do not preserve incompatible values by hidden correction.

fields.name: Discrepancy and actual exchanges
fields.meaning: Model disagreement and mapping residual recorded separately from genuinely physical heat/work/material transfers.
fields.unit_or_basis: Each term has declared dimensions and sign.

invariants: Mapping, reference conversion and target-state resolution are distinct steps in meaning, even if one implementation combines them.
A nonreversible map requires additional assumptions to reconstruct details.
Heat-only coupling is IC-50 and does not instantiate a material translator.
permitted_variants: Same species with two caloric packages.
concepts.lifecycle: Case fixed per attempted translation; changed policies or sources create another case and remain attributable.
concepts.valid_example: Holding T,P,composition exposes corrected enthalpy disagreement; holding corrected H may require another T.
concepts.invalid_example: Inserting an unexplained heat term to preserve incompatible T and H predictions simultaneously.

concepts.name: Process completion scope and run-local view
concepts.meaning: The scope at which a coupled calculation is progressing or must be accepted, together with the candidate set used for further iterations.
concepts.identity_rule: Scope identity fixes operation/stage/unit/flowsheet role and parent; run-local view identity fixes captured context and iteration. It is not a published current result.

fields.name: Scope and parent
fields.meaning: Local property/equilibrium, stage, unit or flowsheet scope; a parent relation is optional only for roots.
fields.unit_or_basis: Containment does not imply parent convergence.

fields.name: Captured revision/run references
fields.meaning: Exact process/dependency context and permitted run supplied by P10.
fields.unit_or_basis: Reference values; source of cancellation authority remains P10.

fields.name: Candidate collection
fields.meaning: The local candidates/qualified states used in this iteration, with compatibility context.
fields.unit_or_basis: No mixture of incompatible parameter revisions or material coordinates.

fields.name: Process residuals and criteria
fields.meaning: Unit/flowsheet constraints, recycle comparisons and required completion evidence.
fields.unit_or_basis: Predeclared residual and tolerance definitions.

fields.name: Publication-group intent
fields.meaning: Which related locations/results are to be adopted together at the claimed scope.
fields.unit_or_basis: Diagnostic partial results are separately labeled.

invariants: Local results may feed the next iteration without being accepted whole-flowsheet results.
Exhausted parent iteration remains unaccepted even if every child flash converged.
Related outlet states cannot be published as a completed unit set from incompatible runs.
permitted_variants: A unit-local checking scope within a larger run.
concepts.lifecycle: New view per iteration or coherent update; retain history separately from P10's current binding.
concepts.valid_example: A converged flash inside an unconverged recycle is inspectable and usable within that run only at its achieved scope.
concepts.invalid_example: Two locally good exchanger outputs from different parameter revisions are published as one accepted exchanger state.

concepts.name: Provider realization and capability attestation
concepts.meaning: The actual engine/build/binding/data realization and the operation combinations that the adapter exposes. It does not inherit every capability of an upstream project.
concepts.identity_rule: Realization identity fixes engine artifact, build/options, binding/adapter revision, linked data and relevant environment. Attestations are separately versioned evidence about that realization.

fields.name: Implementation/dependency manifest
fields.meaning: Engine, adapter, binding, enabled modules, exact data bundles and known availability conditions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact artifact identities; required missing artifacts remain explicit.

fields.name: Semantic realization mapping
fields.meaning: Which configured methods and operation contracts are implemented, including whole-bundle versus submodel boundary.
fields.unit_or_basis: Mapped role/convention meanings, not names alone.

fields.name: Capability predicates
fields.meaning: Supported, unsupported or unassessed combinations of representation/model, phases, input specifications, properties, derivatives and initializer conditions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Conditions and evidence levels; method existence is not runtime validation.

fields.name: Provider coordinates
fields.meaning: Native order, units and phase/species mappings for exact realizations.
fields.unit_or_basis: No provider coordinates become canonical material identity.

fields.name: Lifecycle constraints
fields.meaning: Sharing, reentrancy, activation, failure/cancellation and reference-state lifetime qualifications.
fields.unit_or_basis: Unknown lifecycle behavior requires conservative control, not a false guarantee.

fields.name: Opacity and limitations
fields.meaning: Which internal choices are attributable and which remain unknown; claim limits and unresolved dependencies.
fields.unit_or_basis: Opaque but pinned data permitted with bounded reproduction claims.

invariants: A wrapper available without its required engine is not executable.
Source inspection, exercised execution and independent validation are separate levels.
An adapter may realize several conceptual packages internally without replacing host authority.
concepts.lifecycle: Revision on relevant implementation/data changes; sessions and results retain exact realization identity.
concepts.valid_example: A TP-only adapter declares PH unsupported although the upstream library has a PH implementation elsewhere.
concepts.invalid_example: A solids parameter whose implementation rejects solids is registered as working precipitation.

concepts.name: Execution plan and attempt record
concepts.meaning: How one captured physical problem will be attempted, or was attempted, using a compatible realization and numerical policy. An attempt is not the physical problem itself.
concepts.identity_rule: Attempt identity is unique within a run and references exactly one original or explicitly alternative physical problem. Retry parentage retained.

fields.name: Problem and captured context
fields.meaning: Original physical problem plus supplied revision/run token and intended completion scope.
fields.unit_or_basis: No mutable reference to current inputs.

fields.name: Realization and numerical policy
fields.meaning: Chosen eligible provider and configured algorithms/limits.
fields.unit_or_basis: Independent of physical-policy identity.

fields.name: Initialization/continuation input
fields.meaning: Guesses, phase seeds, prior compatible result references and eligibility evidence.
fields.unit_or_basis: Numerical role and validity bound explicit.

fields.name: Attempt relations and interventions
fields.meaning: Retry parent, altered-problem proposal, temporary fixes or relaxations and restoration checks.
fields.unit_or_basis: Changed physics points to another IC-35; no hidden rewrite.

fields.name: Execution state and evidence
fields.meaning: Planned, running, terminated, cancelled or failed and actual used methods/search/termination details.
fields.unit_or_basis: Execution times differ from physical process time.

invariants: A plan can be rejected before provider evaluation.
Numerical relaxation or temporary fixing is not accepted as the original problem until original checks are restored.
A new attempt must not reclassify an unapproved alternate model as same-problem success.
permitted_variants: One parameter-fit evaluation under a fixed trial package.
concepts.lifecycle: Plan/capture then execute; completed records are evidence. Work buffers live in session/workspace and do not become source definitions.
concepts.valid_example: Two different algorithms can attempt the same PH target with distinct attempt records.
concepts.invalid_example: The second attempt narrows physical phase scope but keeps the same original problem identity unqualified.

concepts.name: Session and workspace lifecycle record
concepts.meaning: The declared compatibility and actual health of a provider runtime context, including its private numerical buffers. A handle is not a material definition or saved scientific result.
concepts.identity_rule: Session identity is runtime-scoped; compatibility key references exact relevant configuration/realization/conventions. Recreated sessions get new runtime identity even when semantically equivalent.

fields.name: Realization and compatibility key
fields.meaning: Provider/build/binding and exact material/data/convention/coordinate revisions required for safe reuse.
fields.unit_or_basis: No mutable current-stream pointer as scientific identity.

fields.name: Sharing/isolation contract
fields.meaning: Exclusive, serialized sequence, independently reentrant or other tested/qualified sharing policy.
fields.unit_or_basis: Internal parallelism does not imply host-level independent session safety.

fields.name: Workspace and active-call association
fields.meaning: Private guesses, scratch arrays and active attempt ownership with explicit isolation scope.
fields.unit_or_basis: Runtime state only; no persisted authority from buffers.

fields.name: Health and recovery evidence
fields.meaning: Usable, uncertain, quarantined, reconstructed, retired or unassessed health and conditions for reuse.
fields.unit_or_basis: A previous successful result does not validate a failed retained buffer.

fields.name: Reference/configuration invalidation
fields.meaning: Events that require rebuilding, resetting or proving compatibility before reuse.
fields.unit_or_basis: Changed reference, material coordinates or parameter bundle explicit.

invariants: No canonical material/state/acceptance authority is transferred to native working memory.
If safe recovery is unknown, retire/reconstruct rather than assume unchanged state.
Opaque native handles cannot be serialized as reconstructable physics.
permitted_variants: One-shot provider process or disposable context.
concepts.lifecycle: Create -> qualified use -> reuse assessment or quarantine -> reset/rebuild/retire. No execution guarantee is inferred without build-specific testing.
concepts.valid_example: A failed native update retires the session while the host retains the previously accepted state.
concepts.invalid_example: Another request reads leftover properties from a failed work buffer as if newly calculated.

concepts.name: Provider candidate and execution evidence
concepts.meaning: The normalized values or mathematical contribution actually returned, plus how they were obtained and what failed or remained uncomputed. It is not an acceptance verdict.
concepts.identity_rule: Candidate identity fixes producing attempt/problem and payload snapshot; later evidence augments lineage without changing original values.

fields.name: Attempt and original problem
fields.meaning: Exact source attempt and physical question.
fields.unit_or_basis: Captured revisions and conventions.

fields.name: Returned payload
fields.meaning: Normalized states, quantity assertions, derivatives or contribution data; may be partial or absent on failure.
fields.unit_or_basis: Native ordering/units converted with explicit maps.

fields.name: Per-output completion
fields.meaning: Computed, unavailable, not requested, failed or unassessed status for promised/required outputs.
fields.unit_or_basis: Known zero separate from missing; role and scope explicit.

fields.name: Actually used assumptions
fields.meaning: Methods/data, phases searched, chemistry restrictions, branches and any departures from request.
fields.unit_or_basis: Requested-versus-used differences retained.

fields.name: Numerical evidence
fields.meaning: Termination criteria, residuals, iterations, conditioning and derivative method evidence where available.
fields.unit_or_basis: Provider residuals not automatically independent physical checks.

fields.name: Exchange realizations
fields.meaning: Actual modeled reservoir/material/energy exchanges needed by the solve.
fields.unit_or_basis: Signed amounts/rates, basis and reference conventions.

invariants: Candidate production does not authorize current publication.
A numerical success with failed physical target remains a candidate with failed acceptance.
Absent promised information is represented, not filled with default values.
permitted_variants: Failed solve with inspectable trial data.
concepts.lifecycle: Immutable normalized evidence sent to P09; provider-private scratch arrays are detached or safely retained without aliasing accepted state.
concepts.valid_example: A flash returns phase allocation plus missing viscosity, matching a primary equilibrium/optional-viscosity contract.
concepts.invalid_example: A candidate is considered fully populated because a library returned an object.

concepts.name: Initialization and continuation description
concepts.meaning: Admissible starting information for an operation, including limitations and reversible numerical interventions. It cannot silently become an original user specification.
concepts.identity_rule: Identity fixes source context, guess/continuation values, preparation policy and compatibility assessment with target problem.

fields.name: Target problem and preparation needs
fields.meaning: Exact operation and initializer restrictions to be satisfied.
fields.unit_or_basis: Phase region, chart, amounts and reference requirements explicit.

fields.name: Seed values and origin
fields.meaning: User guesses, previous results, phase-envelope information, phase candidates or equation fixings.
fields.unit_or_basis: Roles remain numerical seeds, not fixed physical inputs.

fields.name: Compatibility/eligibility
fields.meaning: Admissible, missing, failed or unassessed preparation and reason.
fields.unit_or_basis: Failure of preparation is not proof of infeasibility.

fields.name: Temporary interventions
fields.meaning: Fix/unfix, constraint relaxation or altered trial system and required restoration evidence.
fields.unit_or_basis: Original problem retained and final checks refer to it.

fields.name: Reuse limits
fields.meaning: Conditions under which seeds remain meaningful after data, phase, coordinate or branch change.
fields.unit_or_basis: No blindly shared stale guess with altered meanings.

invariants: A missing initializer can block an otherwise representable/evaluable problem.
An incipient phase seed is not present material.
Initialization that changes physics is an explicitly temporary or alternative problem, not hidden production behavior.
permitted_variants: Staged initialization for a coupled equation model.
concepts.lifecycle: Prepare for one captured target; new target compatibility needs assessment; successful preparation not identical to solved state.
concepts.valid_example: A prior liquid composition seeds a new calculation while the original overall component totals remain fixed.
concepts.invalid_example: A guessed temperature is left as an extra fixed constraint after initialization.

concepts.name: Provider coordinate and convention binding
concepts.meaning: The executable mapping from semantic material/property coordinates into a particular provider and back. It instantiates P01 map meaning without changing canonical identity.
concepts.identity_rule: Binding revision fixes provider realization, host representation/coordinate revisions, native order, units, phase labels and conventions.

fields.name: Host coordinate meaning
fields.meaning: Semantic representation, composition charts and relevant quantity conventions.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact revisions.

fields.name: Native coordinate description
fields.meaning: Provider constituent order/IDs, supported bases, phase slots and output axes.
fields.unit_or_basis: Native units/references are explicitly distinguished from host display units.

fields.name: Bidirectional mappings
fields.meaning: Permutation, basis/reference conversions and result normalization, with direction-specific limits.
fields.unit_or_basis: Incomplete/lossy transformations may have no valid inverse.

fields.name: Native placeholders
fields.meaning: Numerical-only entries/sentinel meanings and rules excluding them from physical accounting.
fields.unit_or_basis: No fabricated material, properties or capability from placeholder data.

fields.name: Capability/context constraints
fields.meaning: When mapping is admissible and which native lifecycle associations are required.
fields.unit_or_basis: Bound to provider realization and exact material scope.

invariants: All vectors and derivative axes must use the matching coordinate map, not just composition.
Native liquid1/liquid2 labels are not automatically physical phase history or light/heavy ports.
Adapter-only placeholders cannot justify a physically unsupported operation.
permitted_variants: Native fixed-slot phase result normalized into role-qualified entries.
concepts.lifecycle: Rebuild/reassess when native/host order or definitions change; save mapping semantics, not a raw handle.
concepts.valid_example: Reversing component order remaps composition, property vectors and Jacobian axes consistently.
concepts.invalid_example: Composition is remapped but binary parameters or derivatives retain the old order.

concepts.name: Check result and evidence evaluation
concepts.meaning: The evidence-based pass/fail/not-assessed assessment of one declared check against an original problem and candidate.
concepts.identity_rule: Check-result identity fixes obligation, candidate, evidence inputs and assessment revision; it does not rewrite the tolerance or original target.

fields.name: Obligation and subject
fields.meaning: The exact check criterion and candidate/original problem assessed.
fields.unit_or_basis: Original target and captured context.

fields.name: Evidence inputs
fields.meaning: Candidate values, reevaluations, process residuals, sources or an explicit unavailable-evidence record.
fields.unit_or_basis: Same-model versus independent provenance stated.

fields.name: Measured residual and scale
fields.meaning: Absolute residual, scale, normalized value, units and tolerance applied.
fields.unit_or_basis: Unavailable residual is not zero; cancellation-safe scale policy retained.

fields.name: Conclusion and applicability
fields.meaning: Pass, fail, not assessed or not applicable with reason; mandatory role inherited from obligation.
fields.unit_or_basis: No inference of physical validity beyond check scope.

fields.name: Evidence dependence
fields.meaning: What depends on the same model/data/solver and what is independent.
fields.unit_or_basis: Reevaluation may check consistency without validating model fidelity.

invariants: Required-check absence blocks corresponding acceptance scope.
Provider convergence is evidence, not an automatic passed target check.
A check based on missing element coefficients cannot certify elemental conservation.
concepts.lifecycle: Append immutable assessment; later evidence leads to another assessment retaining originals.
concepts.valid_example: The original PH target is compared against recomputed enthalpy with recorded model provenance.
concepts.invalid_example: Agreement of two evaluations sharing the same model is labeled independent experimental validation.

concepts.name: Qualified result and acceptance assessment
concepts.meaning: What a candidate establishes for a specified physical problem and completion scope after required checks, independently of whether that result is current.
concepts.identity_rule: Assessment identity fixes candidate set, original problem(s), scope, check obligations and evidence revision.

fields.name: Candidate and problem set
fields.meaning: Consistent candidate values and the exact questions they answer.
fields.unit_or_basis: No unqualified mixture of model revisions.

fields.name: Required scope and check set
fields.meaning: Property/local/unit/flowsheet acceptance scope and all applicable mandatory/optional checks.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exported scope descriptor; process criteria supplied by coordinator.

fields.name: Outcome and completeness
fields.meaning: Accepted for stated scope, rejected or unassessed; partial-property status preserved.
fields.unit_or_basis: Outcome cause and missing/failed evidence explicit.

fields.name: Independent quality dimensions
fields.meaning: Numerical completion, constraint satisfaction, stability scope, scientific applicability, provenance completeness and validation evidence.
fields.unit_or_basis: Currentness/publication are supplied facts from P10, not changed historical judgments.

fields.name: Additional evidence needs
fields.meaning: Bounded requests for required missing evaluations under original conventions.
fields.unit_or_basis: No permission to change targets or physics.

fields.name: Lineage
fields.meaning: Trace to definitions, inputs and actual execution evidence.
fields.unit_or_basis: Reproducibility limitations retained.

invariants: Local acceptance does not imply unit/flowsheet convergence.
Historically valid does not mean current.
Accepted under an authorized approximation must retain that approximation label.
concepts.lifecycle: P09 publishes assessments as evidence; P10 decides whether a referenced assessment may bind the current state.
concepts.valid_example: A revision-A result remains scientifically assessed for A after revision B becomes current.
concepts.invalid_example: A valid A result bypasses the current revision guard and overwrites B.

concepts.name: Coverage and validation claim
concepts.meaning: A bounded statement of representability, execution, implementation conformance or independent physical validation for a particular scenario/configuration.
concepts.identity_rule: Claim identity fixes subject scenario/profile, package/realization, envelope, evidence kind and evidence revision. Evidence dimensions are independent, not automatic promotions.

fields.name: Claim subject
fields.meaning: Scenario and exact material/model/data/operation/phase/chemistry/formulation scope. Concrete realization/build is required for execution claims, but may be unassigned for a representation-only review.
fields.unit_or_basis: Specified boundary/envelope.

fields.name: Evidence dimensions
fields.meaning: Representable, executable, implementation-conformant, physically consistent, reference-validated or reproducible, each with pass/fail/unassessed status.
fields.unit_or_basis: No inference from a catalog link or documentation claim.

fields.name: Witness records
fields.meaning: Executed fixture, review or reference comparison and actual manifest; absent witnesses remain explicit.
fields.unit_or_basis: Predeclared tolerances, error/uncertainty budget and independence.

fields.name: Limitations and gaps
fields.meaning: Unassessed combinations, invalidated evidence and unmet P1/P2 delivery obligations.
fields.unit_or_basis: Provider unsupported does not close program scope.

invariants: A source method or API argument is not an executed capability witness.
Passing synthetic contract arithmetic cannot validate a real-fluid model.
Agreement between providers sharing methods/data does not alone establish independent validation.
concepts.lifecycle: Add/retire claims with evidence; retain historic witness conditions and never expand scope silently.
concepts.valid_example: A TP fixture adds evidence only for its declared material/model/conditions, not arbitrary reactive PH calculations.
concepts.invalid_example: All 34 scenarios have mappings, so the simulator is advertised as validated for them.

concepts.name: Result lineage and attribution
concepts.meaning: The dependency and provenance record explaining what physical problem, data and implementation produced a result, including requested-versus-used differences.
concepts.identity_rule: Lineage identity is tied to exact result/assessment evidence. It references immutable subjects rather than whatever happens to be current.

fields.name: Definition and input references
fields.meaning: Material/representation, data, chemistry, package, binding/constraint descriptors and supplied state revisions actually used.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact revisions; unknown provenance explicit.

fields.name: Implementation and execution references
fields.meaning: Realization, attempt, numerical policy, consequential seeds/branch and candidate evidence.
fields.unit_or_basis: Actual build/binding/data manifest.

fields.name: Requested-versus-used distinctions
fields.meaning: All relevant deviations, estimated/substituted data and alternate-problem linkage.
fields.unit_or_basis: No retrospective relabeling under current defaults.

fields.name: Assessment and reproduction links
fields.meaning: Checks and validation/reproduction evidence attributed to this exact result.
fields.unit_or_basis: Independent data distinguished from reused calculations.

fields.name: Completeness of attribution
fields.meaning: Complete for stated claim, limited or unassessed, with missing required facts.
fields.unit_or_basis: Missing lineage lowers the claim rather than inventing metadata.

invariants: A provider upgrade cannot retroactively become the producer of old results.
A reduced representation keeps its information-loss/assumption ancestry.
permitted_variants: Pinned whole-provider bundle with limited internals.
concepts.lifecycle: Append evidence; preserve original producer/configuration association indefinitely for retained history.
concepts.valid_example: A downstream duty retains the fact that its interaction parameter was estimated and later approved.
concepts.invalid_example: An old result is exported with today's database version in its provenance.

concepts.name: Operation outcome and diagnostic statement
concepts.meaning: The vocabulary and structure for reporting known outcomes, incomplete outputs and causes. Providers instantiate it; P09 owns its interpretation.
concepts.identity_rule: Statement identity identifies affected request/attempt/property/scope and source. Cause chains and per-property statements may coexist.

fields.name: Affected subject and stage
fields.meaning: Operation, property, location, attempt or required check and where failure/limitation occurred.
fields.unit_or_basis: Precise scope, not only a generic exception text.

fields.name: Outcome category
fields.meaning: Use B4 categories: unknown identity, inconsistent/incomplete spec, authority conflict, unsupported/unassessed capability, missing data/dependency, incompatible references, domain, initializer, feasibility, branch, nonconvergence, checks, provider, cancellation/obsolete, optional property.
fields.unit_or_basis: Semantic categories, not a required implementation enum.

fields.name: Known cause and evidence
fields.meaning: What is actually established; unknown native cause remains unknown; original provider detail retained where usable.
fields.unit_or_basis: No infeasibility inference from a generic numerical exception.

fields.name: Output qualification
fields.meaning: Which candidate outputs remain available, unaccepted or independently usable.
fields.unit_or_basis: No absent quantity filled with zero.

fields.name: Remedy or alternate problem link
fields.meaning: Missing prerequisites, required authorized change or separate alternate-problem result.
fields.unit_or_basis: Recommendation is not automatic permission to change physics.

invariants: A failed optional property can coexist with primary-operation success.
A provider failure, initialization failure and demonstrated infeasibility are different.
Changed physical assumptions are retained as qualifications, not erased by a success label.
permitted_variants: Nested numerical failure with retained cause chain.
concepts.lifecycle: Immutable statement per event/outcome; later recovery does not erase the original attempt's meaning.
concepts.valid_example: PH blocked by missing ideal caloric data is not reported as an impossible physical state.
concepts.invalid_example: All native errors are converted into unsupported model or zero property.

concepts.name: Revision and dependency context
concepts.meaning: The exact semantic and realization references captured for a model, calculation or result and the dependency scope used for currency checks.
concepts.identity_rule: Context identity distinguishes entity lineage, immutable revision and snapshot of relevant dependencies. Content hash, semantic equivalence and current binding are different relations.

fields.name: Revision identity and lineage
fields.meaning: Stable entity lineage, exact immutable revision and optional parent/change ancestry.
fields.unit_or_basis: Renaming/display changes separated from physical meaning.

fields.name: Dependency set
fields.meaning: Material/data/method/chemistry/binding/specification and relevant implementation references captured together.
fields.unit_or_basis: Exact revisions, not mutable aliases.

fields.name: Dependency completeness
fields.meaning: Exact relevant subset or conservative superset with known uncertainty.
fields.unit_or_basis: Unknown impact cannot leave possibly stale results current.

fields.name: Equivalence/compatibility evidence
fields.meaning: Explicit assessment for reuse under changed physical/presentation/numerical/implementation context.
fields.unit_or_basis: Equal hashes are not proof of scientific equivalence.

fields.name: Context kind
fields.meaning: Approved model, trial proposal, historical snapshot or captured calculation context.
fields.unit_or_basis: Trial may be complete without production approval.

invariants: A current pointer cannot stand in for the immutable context of a past result.
Physical, numerical, implementation and presentation revisions can have different invalidation consequences.
Revision ancestry is acyclic even though scientific/reference graphs may contain cycles.
concepts.lifecycle: P10 commits new revisions; old references remain valid history. Selective invalidation is optional when conservative treatment is correct.
concepts.valid_example: A changed binary parameter invalidates all contexts that used its old revision.
concepts.invalid_example: A cached state only checks component names and misses a changed reference convention.

concepts.name: Coordinated change and impact proposal
concepts.meaning: A proposed semantic edit with explicit quantity preservation, domain validations and dependency effects before anything becomes current.
concepts.identity_rule: Change identity captures expected prior revision, proposed revisions, authorized intent and assessment results.

fields.name: Expected prior context
fields.meaning: The model/dependency revision against which the edit is proposed.
fields.unit_or_basis: Stale edits require explicit reconcile/retry, not silent overwrite.

fields.name: Proposed domain changes
fields.meaning: Validated proposals from material, data, chemistry, package, state or binding owners.
fields.unit_or_basis: Content owners remain responsible for meaning.

fields.name: Quantity-preservation policy
fields.meaning: Required for material edits: preserve remaining component quantities, preserve total with authorized renormalization, or explicit other rule.
fields.unit_or_basis: Removed material is not silently redistributed.

fields.name: Dependency/impact assessment
fields.meaning: Affected definitions, results, sessions and unresolved references, exact or conservative.
fields.unit_or_basis: Physical versus numerical versus presentation effects distinguished.

fields.name: Disposition and committed revision
fields.meaning: Proposed, rejected, pending reconciliation or committed with exact new context.
fields.unit_or_basis: No partial live adoption of an inconsistent coordinated set.

invariants: Removing an active reaction species cannot leave that reaction ready without repair.
A characterization proposal may require material and parameter updates to be adopted together.
Every interface uses the same edit semantics, not construction-history heuristics.
concepts.lifecycle: Prepare -> domain-check/impact -> revision-checked commit or explicit rejection; undo is a new controlled restoration, not erasure of history.
concepts.valid_example: Removing A while preserving B=3 kg/s changes totals explicitly and invalidates affected state calculations.
concepts.invalid_example: One editor preserves total and another preserves component flows without exposing the difference.

concepts.name: Publication proposal and decision
concepts.meaning: The coordinated decision to adopt a qualified result set for a current location/scope under matching revision and live run authority.
concepts.identity_rule: Proposal/decision identity references exact qualification, target binding slots, expected revision and run token. Rejected proposals remain attributable.

fields.name: Qualified result set
fields.meaning: Accepted-for-scope assessments and corresponding candidate snapshots.
fields.unit_or_basis: Related outputs form one coherent proposed set.

fields.name: Target location/scope
fields.meaning: Where the result is proposed as current and whether it publishes constraints, allocation, state or whole-scope completion.
fields.unit_or_basis: No implicit promotion from unit constraints to completed state.

fields.name: Expected context and run authority
fields.meaning: Matching revision/dependency set and permitted noncancelled run/supersession context.
fields.unit_or_basis: Checked at same logical commit point as binding update.
